id: Prajurit yang mempunyai zirah lengkap muncul di cerita tentang migrasi sekelompok pengungsi menuju El Gaia. Setelah menyelamatkan Reed dan grupnya dari bahaya berkali-kali, semua orang mengakui keahliannya, meskipun masa lalu dan identitasnya tetap sebuah misteri karena dia tidak pernah melepaskan helm di depan orang lain. Karena ada yang bilang bahwa Eru, prajurit dari Kekaisaran Bariura, kadang menatap Nevsky sambil sepertinya berpikir sendiri, banyak yang percaya bahwa mereka berasal dari negara yang sama. Tapi, tidak ada bukti konkrit yang ditemukan.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50324_DESCRIPTION
desc: A heavily armored soldier who appears in the tales about the migration of a group of refugees towards El Gaia. Having rescued Reed and his party from danger an innumerable amount of times, everyone acknowledged his ability, though his past and identity remained a total mystery since he never took off his helmet in front of others. Due to some reports left over which state that Eru, a soldier from the Bariura Empire, sometimes gazed at Nevsky as if thinking to himself, many believe they hailed from the same country. However, no conclusive evidence of this has been found.

However, no conclusive evidence of this has been found.
raw.es: Un soldado blindado que se menciona en los cuentos sobre la migración de un grupo de refugiados hacia Elgaia. Tras haber rescatado a Reed y a su grupo del peligro en innumerables ocasiones, todos reconocían su habilidad, aunque su pasado e identidad seguían siendo un completo misterio, ya que no se quitaba el casco delante de los demás. Debido a algunos informes olvidados que dicen que Eru, un soldado del imperio Bariura, logró ver a Nevsky pensando para sus adentros, muchos creen que ambos provenían de la misma nación. Sin embargo, no se ha encontrado prueba evidente de esta teoría.

Karena ada yang bilang bahwa Eru, prajurit dari Kekaisaran Bariura, kadang menatap Nevsky sambil sepertinya berpikir sendiri, banyak yang percaya bahwa mereka berasal dari negara yang sama. Tapi, tidak ada bukti konkrit yang ditemukan.
raw.pt: Um soldado de armadura pesada que aparece nos contos sobre a migração de um grupo de refugiados em direção a El Gaia. Tendo resgatado Reed e seu grupo do perigo por incontáveis vezes, todos reconheceram sua habilidade, embora seu passado e identidade tenham permanecido um mistério total já que ele nunca tirava o elmo na frente dos outros. Existem alguns relatos que dizem que Eru, um soldado do Império Bariura, às vezes olhava para Nevsky como se estivesse vendo a si mesmo, o que leva muitos a acreditarem que ambos vieram do mesmo lugar. Porém, nunca se encontrou provas disso.
raw.th: ทหารเกราะหนักที่ปรากฏในเรื่องเล่าเกี่ยวกับการย้ายถิ่นของกลุ่มผู้ลี้ภัยไปสู่เอลไกอา ได้ช่วยเหลือรีดและกลุ่มของเขาจากอันตรายเป็นจำนวนนับครั้งไม่ถ้วน ทุกคนยอมรับความสามารถของเขา แม้ว่าในอดีตและตัวตนของเขานั้นจะยังคงเป็นเรื่องลึกลับ เพราะว่าเขาไม่เคยถอดหมวกเกราะต่อหน้าผู้ใดเลย เนื่องจากบางรายงานที่ถูกทิ้งเอาไว้ได้กล่าวว่าเอรุ ทหารจากจักรวรรดิบาลิอุระ บางครั้งก็จ้องมองไปที่เนฟสกี้คล้ายกับกำลังครุ่นคิดกับตัวเอง หลายคนเชื่อว่าพวกเขามาจากประเทศเดียวกัน แต่ไม่มีหลักฐานที่สรุปเรื่องนี้เคยถูกค้นพบ
raw.vi: Người lính mặc bộ giáp nặng nề xuất hiện trong các câu chuyện về cuộc di cư của nhóm người tị nạn đến El Gaia. Sau vô số lần cứu Reed và đội của Reed khỏi nguy hiểm, mọi người đã thừa nhận khả năng của anh, mặc dù quá khứ và danh tính của anh vẫn hoàn toàn là bí ẩn vì anh không bao giờ cởi mũ trước mặt người khác. Do một số báo cáo còn sót lại nêu rằng Eru, một người lính đến từ Đế Chế Bariura, đôi khi nhìn chằm chằm vào Nevsky như thể đang nghĩ về bản thân, nhiều người tin họ đến từ cùng một quốc gia. Tuy nhiên, người ta chưa tìm thấy bằng chứng thuyết phục nào cho việc này.

id: A heavily armored soldier who appears in the tales about the migration of a group of refugees towards Elgaia. After arriving before Lucius's gate, Nevsky sensed an incoming attack from the God Army. Seeing that another man was attempting to use his own body as a blockade against the attack to buy the refugees more time to escape, Nevsky silently made his way towards him, joining his blockade with his arms stretched out beside him. There are no records left stating what happened to him following this, but the fact that many refugees were able to make it safely to Elgaia may be proof that his attempt to protect them was successful.

id: Teknisi tua, disisihkan bahkan di tanah airnya, Republik La Veda. Sejak muda berlatih seni sihir Terang, menjadi lumayan penting di negaranya sebelum suatu hari tiba-tiba ia menghilang. Saat muncul lagi, ia memegang kunci raksasa. Tidak ada catatan tentang kunci itu, tetapi saat Gilnea kembali, kini ia mampu memakai sihir Gelap, jadi banyak yang percaya itu kunci ke pintu neraka.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50344_DESCRIPTION
desc: An odd technician, seen as an outcast even in his homeland, the La Veda Republic. From a young age he continued training in the art of Light magic, becoming quite prominent in his own country before one day he suddenly vanished. When he reappeared, he was holding a giant key. There is nothing written about the key, but when Gilnea returned he was now able to use Dark magic, leading many to believe the key was to the door to hell.

raw.en: An odd technician, seen as an outcast even in his homeland, the La Veda Republic. From a young age he continued training in the art of Light magic, becoming quite prominent in his own country before one day he suddenly vanished. When he reappeared, he was holding a giant key. There is nothing written about the key, but when Gilnea returned he was now able to use Dark magic, leading many to believe the key was to the door to hell.
raw.es: Técnico extraño, catalogado como marginado incluso en su país natal, la república de La Veda. Desde crío continuó entrenando en el arte de la magia lumínica y se convirtió en una persona importante en su patria antes de desaparecer de forma repentina. Cuando volvió, llevaba consigo una llave gigante. No hay nada escrito sobre la llave, pero cuando Gilnea regresó, podía utilizar magia oscura, lo que llevó a muchos a pensar que la llave abría las puertas del infierno.
raw.id: Teknisi tua, disisihkan bahkan di tanah airnya, Republik La Veda. Sejak muda berlatih seni sihir Terang, menjadi lumayan penting di negaranya sebelum suatu hari tiba-tiba ia menghilang. Saat muncul lagi, ia memegang kunci raksasa. Tidak ada catatan tentang kunci itu, tetapi saat Gilnea kembali, kini ia mampu memakai sihir Gelap, jadi banyak yang percaya itu kunci ke pintu neraka.
raw.pt: Um técnico estranho, visto como pária mesmo em sua terra natal, a República de La Veda. Desde cedo ele continuou a trabalhar com a magia da luz, se tornando famoso em seu continente antes de sumir subitamente. Quando reapareceu, portava uma chave gigante. Não há nada escrito sobre a chave, mas quando Gilnea voltou ele podia usar magia das Sombras, levando muitos a acreditar que a chave era para o inferno.
raw.th: ช่างที่ทำตัวแปลก ถูกมองว่าเป็นคนจรจัดแม้แต่ในสาธารณรัฐลา วีด้า แผ่นดินบ้านเกิด ในช่วงอายุน้อยเขาได้ฝึกฝนวิชาเวทมนตร์ กลายเป็นที่โดดเด่นมากในประเทศของตัวเองก่อนที่วันหนึ่งเขาก็หายตัวไป เมื่อเขาปรากฎตัวอีกครั้ง เขาก็ถือกุญแจยักษ์ไม่มีการเขียนบันทึกอะไรเกี่ยวกับกุญแจ แต่เมื่อกิลเนียกลับมาเขาก็สามารถใช้เวทมนตร์ดำได้ ทำให้หลายคนเชื่อว่านี่เป็นกุญแจของประตูนรก
raw.vi: Một nhà kỹ thuật kì lạ, bị coi là kẻ bị ruồng bỏ ngay chính trên quê hương của mình, Cộng hòa La Veda. Từ khi còn nhỏ tuổi, anh đã được đào tạo về nghệ thuật của Ma thuật ánh sáng, anh đã trở nên khá nổi tiếng trên quê hương của mình, cho đến một ngày anh đột nhiên biến mất. Khi xuất hiện trở lại, anh nắm giữ một chiếc chìa khóa khổng lồ. Không có ghi chép gì về chiếc chìa khóa này, nhưng khi Gilnea trở về, thì anh giờ đã có thể sử dụng Phép thuật hắc ám, khiến cho nhiều người tin rằng đây chính là chiếc chìa khóa mở cửa địa ngục.

id: Totem yang dibuat para dewa, memuat semua elemen. Cerita rakyat mengisahkan bagaimana totem ini berisi kekuatan paling hebat. Memanfaatkan keenam elemen yang ada di dunia, sifat sucinya membuat banyak orang memujanya sebagai dewa. Katanya, orang-orang yang percaya pada kekuatannya akan berkata, "Dia yang memegang Totem Mukjizat akan memegang kekuatan untuk mengatasi para dewa."
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50354_DESCRIPTION
desc: A totem created by the gods, embodying all elements. Folklore speaks of how this totem held within itself the greatest of powers. Harnessing all six of the elements that existed in the world, its sacred nature brought many to worship it as a god. It's said that believers in its power would say, "He who holds the Miracle Totem holds the power to overcome the gods."

raw.en: A totem created by the gods, embodying all elements. Folklore speaks of how this totem held within itself the greatest of powers. Harnessing all six of the elements that existed in the world, its sacred nature brought many to worship it as a god. It's said that believers in its power would say, "He who holds the Miracle Totem holds the power to overcome the gods."
raw.es: Tótem creado por los dioses que personificaba a todos los elementos. Las historias cuentan que dentro de este tótem se escondían los poderes más grandiosos. Al reunir los seis elementos que existían en el mundo, su naturaleza sagrada atrajo a muchos, que comenzaron a adorarlo cual dios. Se dice que muchos creyentes afirmaban que "quien tenga el poder del Tótem milagroso, tendrá el poder para sobrepasar a los dioses".
raw.id: Totem yang dibuat para dewa, memuat semua elemen. Cerita rakyat mengisahkan bagaimana totem ini berisi kekuatan paling hebat. Memanfaatkan keenam elemen yang ada di dunia, sifat sucinya membuat banyak orang memujanya sebagai dewa. Katanya, orang-orang yang percaya pada kekuatannya akan berkata, "Dia yang memegang Totem Mukjizat akan memegang kekuatan untuk mengatasi para dewa."
raw.pt: Um totem criado pelos deuses, personificando todos os elementos. O folclore fala sobre como este totem possuía dentro de si os maiores poderes. Reunindo todos os seis elementos que existem no mundo, sua natureza sagrada levou muitos a venerá-lo como divindade. Dizem que aqueles que crêem no seu poder dizem que “aquele que possui o Totem Milagroso possui o poder de superar os deuses”.
raw.th: โทเทมที่ถูกสร้างโดยเทพเจ้า, มีร่างที่รวมทุกธาตุเอาไว้ นิทานพื้นบ้านเล่าถึงว่าโทเทมเหล่านี้เก็บพลังมหาศาลไว้กับตัว การควบคุมธาตุทั้งหกที่มีอยู่ในโลกและธรรมชาติที่ศักดิ์สิทธิ์ของมันทำให้ผู้คนบูชาดุจเทพ ว่ากันว่าผู้ที่เชื่อในพลังของมันจะพูดว่า "ใครก็ตามที่ได้ครองพลังของมิราเคิลโทเทม จะได้ครองพลังที่เหนือกว่าเทพเจ้า"
raw.vi: Một thần vật do các vị thần tạo ra, là hiện thân cho tất cả các yếu tố. Văn học dân gian kể về cách các thần vật này nắm giữ một sức mạnh vĩ đại nhất bên trong. Khai thác tất cả 6 yếu tố tồn tại trên thế giới, tính thiêng liêng của nó khiến nhiều người tôn thờ thần vật như một vị thần. Người ta nói rằng các tín đồ tin vào sức mạnh của thần vật sẽ nói rằng "Anh ta nắm giữ Thần vật huyền diệu thì sẽ nắm giữ sức mạnh vượt qua các vị thần".

id: Makhluk sihir yang katanya membuat sistem dan menyimpan semua pengetahuan tentang Terang yang bisa dibawa Unit Metal. Dewa Kristal jauh lebih langka daripada Dewa Logam, ada konflik tentang keberadaan mereka akibat sedikitnya laporan saksi. Setelah terbukti, mereka awalnya dicatat sebagai subspesies Dewa Logam, tetapi mereka makhluk yang sangat berbeda meski penampilannya mirip. Katanya Dewa Kristal mengatur catatan yang dibawa dalam Dewa Logam, membuat sistem dan merapikan informasi.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50364_DESCRIPTION
desc: This magical creature is said to systemize and store all Light-related knowledge that Metal Units can hold within them. As Crystal Gods are far rarer than Metal Gods, there has been conflict over their existence until recent years due to few witness reports. After their existence had been proven, they were initially recorded as a subspecies of Metal Gods, but they were completely different creatures despite their similar appearance. It is said that Crystal Gods organize the records held within Metal Gods, then systemize and refine the information.

raw.en: This magical creature is said to systemize and store all Light-related knowledge that Metal Units can hold within them. As Crystal Gods are far rarer than Metal Gods, there has been conflict over their existence until recent years due to few witness reports. After their existence had been proven, they were initially recorded as a subspecies of Metal Gods, but they were completely different creatures despite their similar appearance. It is said that Crystal Gods organize the records held within Metal Gods, then systemize and refine the information.
raw.es: Se dice que estas criaturas mágicas logran sistematizar y almacenar todo el conocimiento lumínico que las Unidades de metal pueden contener en su interior. Debido a que la aparición de los Dioses de cristal es menos frecuente que la de los Dioses metálicos, su existencia fue disputada hasta hace algunos años, cuando se lograron registrar los testimonios de varios testigos. Luego de que se comprobó su existencia, se los catalogó como una subespecie de Dioses metálicos. Sin embargo, a pesar de su apariencia similar, son criaturas totalmente distintas. Se dice que los Dioses de cristal organizan los registros que contienen los Dioses metálicos y luego sistematizan y refinan la información.
raw.id: Makhluk sihir yang katanya membuat sistem dan menyimpan semua pengetahuan tentang Terang yang bisa dibawa Unit Metal. Dewa Kristal jauh lebih langka daripada Dewa Logam, ada konflik tentang keberadaan mereka akibat sedikitnya laporan saksi. Setelah terbukti, mereka awalnya dicatat sebagai subspesies Dewa Logam, tetapi mereka makhluk yang sangat berbeda meski penampilannya mirip. Katanya Dewa Kristal mengatur catatan yang dibawa dalam Dewa Logam, membuat sistem dan merapikan informasi.
raw.pt: Dizem que esta criatura mágica organiza e armazena todo o conhecimento sobre luz que unidades de metal conseguem armazenar. Como deuses de cristal são muito mais raros do que deuses de metal, houve um conflito com relação à existência deles até poucos anos atrás, devido a poucos casos testemunhais. Depois que sua existência foi comprovada, eles foram descritos como subespécie dos deuses de metal, mas eram criaturas totalmente diferentes apesar da aparência semelhante. Dizem que os deuses de cristal organizam os registros obtidos entre os deuses de metal e depois refinam e criam um sistema para a informação.
raw.th: ว่ากันว่าสัตว์วิเศษตัวนี้ จัดระบบและเก็บความรู้ทั้งหมดซึ่งเกี่ยวข้องกับแสงที่พวกเมทัลจะสามารถเก็บไว้ในตัวได้ ขณะที่คริสตัลก็อดหาได้ยากยิ่งกว่าเมทัลก็อด ก็มีความขัดแย้งเกี่ยวกับเรื่องการมีอยู่ของพวกมันจนกระทั่งไม่กี่ปีที่ผ่านมานี้ เนื่องจากรายงานที่มีไม่มากเกี่ยวกับการพบเห็นมัน หลังจากที่การมีอยู่ของพวกมันได้รับการยืนยัน ในตอนแรกพวกมันถูกจัดอยู่ในกลุ่มสายพันธุ์ย่อยของเมทัลก็อด แต่อันที่จริงพวกมันเป็นสายพันธุ์ที่แตกต่างกันไปโดยสิ้นเชิงแม้จะมีรูปร่างใกล้เคียงกัน ว่ากันว่าคริสตับก็อดบริหารบันทึกที่มีอยู่ในเมทัลก็อด จากนั้นก็จัดการระบบและปรับแต่งข้อมูล
raw.vi: Sinh vật ma thuật này được cho là hệ thống hóa và lưu trữ tất cả kiến thức liên quan đến Quang mà Quái kim loại có thể giữ bên trong chúng. Vì Thần pha lê hiếm hơn nhiều so với Thần kim loại, đã có mâu thuẫn về sự tồn tại của họ cho đến những năm gần đây do một vài báo cáo của nhân chứng. Sau khi sự tồn tại của họ đã được chứng minh, họ ban đầu được ghi nhận là một phân loài của Thần kim loại, nhưng họ là những sinh vật hoàn toàn khác mặc dù có vẻ ngoài tương tự.  Người ta nói rằng Thần pha lê sắp xếp hồ sơ nắm giữ trong tay Thần kim loại, sau đó hệ thống hóa và tinh chỉnh thông tin.

id: Inkarnasi dari kekuatan Terang yang datang dari dunia lain. Legenda berkata makhluk ini adalah kunci untuk membuka kekuatan yang lebih besar dari para dewa. Meskipun keberadaan mereka diselimuti misteri, katanya para dewa dari dunia lain dipercaya menciptakan makhluk ini untuk melarikan diri dari kehancurannya. Tapi, terang itu terlalu kuat, ironisnya menjadi katalis kehancuran yang akan datang itu. Hari ini, terang itu membantu membersihkan jiwa dari ketidakbahagiaan sebelum pindah ke alam yang lebih tinggi. Kalau seseorang bisa mengontrol kekuatan dari Dewa Meka, kekuatan Terang tak terbatas menjadi milik mereka.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50394_DESCRIPTION
desc: An incarnation of the power of Light from another world. Legend has it these beings are the key to unlocking powers greater than those of the gods. Though their existence is shrouded in mystery, it is believed that gods from another world created these creatures to escape their own destruction. However, the light proved to be too strong, ironically serving as a catalyst for the destruction that was to come. Today, the light helps to cleanse the soul from any unhappiness before it sublimates onto a higher plane. If one is able to control the power of a Mecha God, the power of limitless Light may become theirs.

raw.es: Encarnación del poder lumínico de otro mundo. Se dice que estos seres son la clave para desbloquear poderes más grandes que los de los dioses. Si bien un velo de misterio cubre su existencia, se cree que los dioses de otros mundos crearon a estas criaturas para escapar de su destrucción. Pero la luz fue demasiado potente. Irónicamente, funcionó como catalizador de la destrucción que pronto llegaría. Hoy, la luz quita todo atisbo de tristeza de las almas antes de que viajen a un plano superior. Si alguien logra controlar a un Mecadiós, tendrá acceso a un poder lumínico ilimitado.

raw.pt: Uma encarnação do poder da Luz de outro mundo. Diz a lenda que esses seres são a chave para desbloquear poderes maiores que os dos deuses. Embora sua existência seja um mistério, acredita-se que deuses de outro mundo criaram esses seres para escapar da sua própria destruição. Porém, a luz se mostrou muito forte, ironicamente servindo como catalisadora da destruição que estava por vir. Hoje, a luz ajuda a limpar a alma de qualquer infelicidade antes que se eleve para um plano maior. Se alguém for capaz de controlar o poder de um Deus Mecha, o poder ilimitado da Luz o pertencerá.
raw.th: ผู้กำเนิดจากพลังแห่งแสงจากต่างโลก ตำนานกล่าวไว้ว่าสิ่งนี้คือกุญแจที่จะช่วยปลดปล่อยพลังอันแข็งแกร่งยิ่งกว่าเทพออกมาเพราะการมีอยู่ของมันเป็นเรื่องลึกลับ จึงเชื่อกันว่าเทพจากต่างโลกเป็นผู้สร้างมันขึ้นมาเพื่อให้รอดจากการทำลายล้างของพวกตนอย่างไรก็ตาม ธาตุแสงแสดงให้เห็นถึงความแข็งแกร่ง นำมาซึ่งการทำลายล้าง ในวันนี้ ธาตุแสงช่วยชำระล้างจิตวิญญาณที่ไม่มีความสุขก่อนจะช่วยยกระดับขึ้น หากใครควบคุมพลังของเมคคา ก็อดไว้ได้ พลังแห่งแสงอันไร้ขีดจำกัดนี้จะเป็นของเขา
raw.vi: Một hóa thân của sức mạnh của Ánh sáng đến từ thế giới khác. Truyền thuyết nói rằng những sinh vật này là chìa khóa để mở khóa sức mạnh lớn hơn sức mạnh của các vị thần. Mặc dù sự tồn tại của chúng được che đậy trong màn bí ẩn, nhưng người ta tin rằng các vị thần đến từ thế giới khác đã tạo ra những sinh vật này để thoát khỏi sự hủy diệt của chính họ. Tuy nhiên, ánh sáng tỏ ra quá mạnh, thật trớ trêu lại đóng vai trò là chất xúc tác cho sự hủy diệt đó đến. Ngày nay, ánh sáng giúp gột sạch linh hồn đến từ bất kỳ sự bất hạnh nào trước khi nó thăng hoa lên một cảnh giới cao hơn. Nếu ai đó có thể kiểm soát sức mạnh của Thần Mecha, sức mạnh vô hạn của Ánh sáng có thể trở thành của họ.

id: Pemimpin dari 12 Pelindung Dewa, pelindung tanah para dewa. Berpikiran luas, kuat, dan perhatian dengan kamerad, ia dikagumi banyak orang. Meski kepribadiannya jujur dengan orang sekitar, banyak yang terpukau dengan ketenangannya. Ia akan mencoba meyakinkan sekutu yang gugup dengan bergurau, tapi itu malah membuat semakin gugup. Rumornya Lunaris akan tertawa karena baginya itu sangat lucu.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50383_DESCRIPTION
desc: Leader of the 12 Guardians of the Gods, protectors of the land of the gods. As broad-minded as he was strong, his thoughtfulness for his comrades led to him being greatly admired by many. Though his personality seemed frank to those around him, many were overwhelmed by the solemn air about him. He would try to reassure nervous allies with a joke here and there, but it seems this only made them more anxious. There's a rumor that Lunaris would often laugh at this as she found it highly amusing.

raw.en: Leader of the 12 Guardians of the Gods, protectors of the land of the gods. As broad-minded as he was strong, his thoughtfulness for his comrades led to him being greatly admired by many. Though his personality seemed frank to those around him, many were overwhelmed by the solemn air about him. He would try to reassure nervous allies with a joke here and there, but it seems this only made them more anxious. There's a rumor that Lunaris would often laugh at this as she found it highly amusing.
raw.es: Líder de los 12 Guardianes de los dioses, protectores de la tierra divina. Su mentalidad era muy abierta, y su fuerza, descomunal. La amabilidad que tenía para con sus compañeros le mereció la admiración de muchos. A pesar de que los que lo rodeaban lo consideraban una persona sincera, muchos se veían abrumados por el aura de seriedad que lo rodeaba. En ocasiones, bromeaba para intentar calmar a sus aliados, aunque parece que con esto solo lograba incomodarlos aún más. Se dice que Lunaris solía reírse de esta situación, que catalogaba como muy divertida.

raw.pt: Líder dos 12 Guardiões dos Deuses, protetores da terra dos deuses. Com a mente tão ampla quanto a própria força, o cuidado dele com os companheiros fez com que ele fosse admirado por muitos. Embora sua personalidade parecesse muito franca aos que o cercava, muitos se impressionavam com seu ar solene. Ele tentava tranquilizar aliados nervosos com algumas piadas, mas parece que isso só os deixava mais ansiosos. Há um boato de que Lunaris ria com frequência disso, já que achava muito divertido.
raw.th: ผู้นำของ 12 ผู้พิทักษ์ของเทพเจ้า ผู้ปกป้องดินแดนของเทพเจ้า เขาใจกว้างพอๆ กับความแข็งแกร่ง การใส่ใจกับเหล่าสหายทำให้เขาเป็นที่ชื่นชมโดยคนมากมาย แม้ว่านัสัยของเขาจะดูตรงไปตรงมาสำหรับคนรอบข้าง แต่หลายคนถูกครอบงำโดยบรรยากาศที่ดูศักดิ์สิทธิ์รอบๆ ตัวของเขา เขาพยายามที่จะสร้างความมั่นใจให้กับเพื่อนที่ประหม่าด้วยเรื่องตลกต่างๆ แต่ดูเหมือนว่ามันจะยิ่งทำให้พวกนั้นกลับกังวลมากยิ่งขึ้น มีเรื่องลือว่า ลาริส มักจะหัวเราะกับเรื่องนี้เพราะเธอพบว่ามันบันเทิงเป็นอย่างมาก
raw.vi: Chỉ huy 12 Hộ vệ của các Vị thần, những người bảo vùng đất của các vị thần. Mặc dù có tư tưởng phóng khoáng rõ ràng, nhưng sự quan tâm của anh tới các đồng đội của mình khiến anh được rất nhiều người ngưỡng mộ. Mặc dù tính cách của anh có vẻ thẳng thắn với những người xunh quanh, nhiều người đã bị choáng ngợp bởi không khí trang nghiêm khi nói về anh. Anh sẽ cố gắng trấn an các đồng đội đang lo lắng bằng một câu nói đùa ở đâu đó, nhưng có vẻ việc này chỉ làm họ lo lắng thêm. Có lời đồn rằng Lunaris thường cười vì cô thấy nó rất thú vị.

id: Mantan pemimpin dari 12 Pelindung Dewa yang memberontak melawan para dewa. Pemberontakannya membati Pelindung menjadi 2 kelompok, dan mantan kameradnya terpaksa beradu pedang. Teorinya, perang antara Pelindung sangat membuat para dewa murka dan memegang peranan mengapa para dewa memutuskan menghancurkan manusia. Teori lain yang tidak populer, alasan Sodis berkhianat adalah karena ia mengetahui rencana para dewa dalam menghancurkan manusia, meski dokumentasi yang mendukung ini sedikit.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50384_DESCRIPTION
desc: Former leader of the 12 Guardians of the Gods who rebelled against the gods. His betrayel split the Guardians into two groups and former comrades were forced to clash swords. There is a thoery that states that the battle between the Guardians greatly angered the gods and may have played a part in the gods deciding to destroy the humans. Still yet another thoery, unpopular as it may be, states that the reason Sodis turned on the gods was because he found out about the gods' plans to destroy the humans, though little documentation supports this.

raw.es: Antiguo líder de los 12 Guardianes de los dioses, que se rebelaron contra ellos. Su traición fraccionó a los Guardianes en dos grupos. Esto forzó a que antiguos camaradas tuvieran que enfrentarse en batalla. Existe una teoría que dice que la batalla entre los Guardianes enfureció a los dioses, y es posible que esta situación haya sido muy importante en la decisión de los dioses de destruir a los humanos. También existe otra teoría, aunque menos popular, que cuenta que la razón por la que Sodis decidió traicionar a los dioses fue porque descubrió el plan que tenían las deidades para destruir a la humanidad, aunque no existe documentación que respalde estos datos.

Teorinya, perang antara Pelindung sangat membuat para dewa murka dan memegang peranan mengapa para dewa memutuskan menghancurkan manusia. raw.pt: Ex-líder dos 12 Guardiões dos Deuses que se rebelou contra os deuses. A traição dele dividiu os Guardiões em dois grupos e os ex-colegas se viram forçados a lutar. Há uma teoria que diz que a batalha entre os Guardiões enfureceu os deuses e pode ter sido uma das influências para os deuses decidirem destruir os humanos. E outra teoria, por menos popular que seja, diz que o motivo da rebeldia de Sodis foi ter descoberto os planos dos deuses de destruir os humanos, embora haja pouca documentação para suportar esta ideia.
raw.th: อดีตผู้นำของ 12 ผู้พิทักษ์ ซึ่งกบฎต่อเทพเจ้าในเวลาต่อมา การทรยศของเขาแบ่งกลุ่มผู้พิทักษ์ออกเป็นสองฝ่ายและอดีตสหายก็ถูกบีบให้มาเข่นฆ่ากันเอง มีทฤษฎีหนึ่งที่กล่าวไว้ว่าการต่อสู้ระหว่างผู้พิทักษ์นั้นทำให้เทพเจ้าโกรธเป็นอย่างมากและอาจมีส่วนเกี่ยวข้องกับการที่เทพเจ้าตัดสินใจทำลายล้างมนุษย์ด้วย แต่ก็ยังมีอีกทฤษฎีหนึ่ง ซึ่งไม่โด่งดังเท่าที่มันควรจะเป็นได้กล่าวไว้ว่าเหตุผลที่ โซดิส หันหลังให้กับเทพเจ้าก็เพราะว่าเขาได้ล่วงรู้เกี่ยวกับแผนการณ์ของเทพเจ้าที่จะทำลายล้างมนุษย์ แต่ก็มีเอกสารที่มาสนับสนุนเรื่องนี้น้อยมาก
raw.vi: Cựu chỉ huy 12 Hộ vệ của các Vị thần người đã nổi dậy chống lại các vị thần. Sự phản bộ của anh đã chia đội Hộ vệ thành 2 nhóm và các đồng đội cũ buộc phải đấu kiếm với nhau.  Có một giả thuyết nói rằng trận chiến giữa các Hộ vệ đã làm các vị thần rất tức giận và có thể đã góp phần vào việc khiến các vị thần quyết định hủy diệt loài người. Vẫn là một giả thuyết khác, không phổ biến lắm, nói rằng lý do Sodis chống lại các vị thần là do anh phát hiện ra kế hoạch hủy diệt loài người của các vị thần, mặc dù ít có tài liệu hỗ trợ cho giả thuyết này.

id: Bekas pemimpin dari 12 Pelindung Dewa yang memberontak melawan para dewa. Banyak yang tidak diketahui tentang akhir nasib pengkhianat ini. Banyak teori mulai dari pertempurannya melawan saudaranya, diserang oleh wanita yang mencintainya, sampai tidak mau bertempur dan kehilangan nyawanya, meskipun kebenaran teori-teori ini tidak diketahui. Satu-satunya yang konsisten adalah kekuatan hebat yang dipunyainya. Beberapa orang berteori bahwa kekuatannya yang sangat hebat ini menakutkan bahkan untuk para dewa sekalipun sehingga tidak banyak catatan tentang dia yang ada.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50385_DESCRIPTION
desc: Former leader of the 12 Guardians of the Gods who rebelled against the gods. There are many things that remain unknown about this traitor towards the end of his life. There are many theories ranging from him having clashed with his brother, to having been attacked by a woman who had loved him, to having refused to fight his friends and losing his life, though the truth is yet unknown. All that remains consistent throughout is his great display of strength. Some hypothesize that his strength was so great it scared even the gods which is why little documentation on him remains.

Existen muchas teorías, que van desde una supuesta pelea con su hermano, a un ataque por parte de una antigua amante. Incluso se dice que pudo haberse negado a pelear contra sus amigos y perder la vida, aunque realmente no se conoce la verdad. Lo único que sí coincide en todas estas posibilidades es su magnífica demostración de poder. Algunos creen que su fuerza era tan grande que llegó a asustar incluso a los dioses, y por eso la documentación que existe de este personaje es bastante reducida.

Há muitas teorias que variam entre ele ter batalhado contra o próprio irmão, ter sido atacado pela mulher que o amava e ter se recusado a lutar contra os amigos e perdido a vida, mas a verdade permanece um mistério. raw.th: อดีตผู้นำของ 12 ผู้พิทักษ์ของเทพเจ้าที่กลายเป็นกบฎต่อเหล่าเทพเจ้าเสียเอง ยังมีอีกหลายเรื่องที่ยังไม่มีใครรู้เกี่ยวกับบั้นปลายชีวิตของคนทรยศ มีทฤษฎีมากมายเกี่ยวกับเขาไม่ว่าจะเป็นการต่อสู้แตกหักกับน้องชาย ถูกโจมตีโดยผู้หญิงที่รักเขา หรือแม้แต่ปฏิเสธที่จะสู้กับเพื่อนของเขาและเสียชีวิตลง แต่ความจริงนั้นก็ยังไม่มีใครรู้ สิ่งที่เหลืออยู่ซึ่งตรงสอดคล้องกันก็คือพลังที่แผ่ออกมาอย่างมากมายของเขา บางคนตั้งสมมุติฐานว่าพลังของเขานั้นยิ่งใหญ่มากจนแม้แต่เทพเจ้าก็ยังเกรงกลัว ซึ่งเป็นเหตุผลว่าทำไมจึงมีเอกสารที่เกี่ยวกับเขาเหลืออยู่น้อยมาก
raw.vi: Cựu chỉ huy 12 Hộ vệ của các Vị thần người đã nổi dậy chống lại các vị thần. Có nhiều điều vẫn chưa biết về kẻ phản bội này cho đến cuối đời của anh. Có nhiều giả thuyết từ việc anh có cuộc đụng độ với em trai mình cho đến việc anh bị tấn công bởi người phụ nữ đã từng yêu anh, đến việc từ chối chiến đấu với bạn bè mình và mất mạng, mặc dù sự thật thì chưa được biết rõ. Tất cả những gì duy trì nhất quán xuyên suốt đó là việc cho thấy sức mạnh to lớn của anh. Một số đưa ra giả thuyết rằng sức mạnh của anh rất to lớn khiến ngay cả các vị thần cũng sợ hãi đó là lý do vì sao còn lại ít tài liệu về anh.

id: Satu dari 12 Pelindung dan adik dari pemimpinnya, Sodis. Dia berusaha keras membantu kakaknya, dan akhirnya menjadi anggota Pelindung. Meskipun sangat berbakat sebagai pemain pedang, kepribadiannya yang sangat serius membuat banyak orang menganggapnya terlalu keras. Tapi, banyak yang menebak dia akan bisa lebih baik dari kakaknya kalau dia sudah banyak pengalaman. Satu catatan harian yang ditemukan menyebutkan bahwa dia jatuh cinta pada teman masa kecilnya, meskipun kebenarannya tidak diketahui.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50403_DESCRIPTION
desc: One of the 12 Guardians and younger brother of their leader, Sodis. He did his best in assisting his older brother, eventually becoming a Guardian himself. Though very skilled as a swordsman, his overly serious personality led many to see him as too strict. However, it was suspected that with experience he could surpass his brother as leader. It was also suggested in a diary which was discovered that he might have been in love with a childhood friend, though the truth about this is unknown.

raw.es: Uno de los 12 guardianes y el hermano de menor de Sodis, su líder. Alyut hizo todo lo que estuvo a su alcance para ayudar a su hermano mayor, lo que finalmente le mereció el título de Guardián. Si bien poseía una gran destreza con la espada, su personalidad extremadamente seria causaba en los demás la impresión de que era demasiado severo. De todos modos, se consideraba que si hubiera tenido más experiencia, podría haber superado a su hermano en su papel de líder. En un diario que se descubrió recientemente se menciona que es posible que haya estado enamorado de una compañera de su infancia, aunque la veracidad de esta información sigue siendo un misterio.

Tapi, banyak yang menebak dia akan bisa lebih baik dari kakaknya kalau dia sudah banyak pengalaman. Satu catatan harian yang ditemukan menyebutkan bahwa dia jatuh cinta pada teman masa kecilnya, meskipun kebenarannya tidak diketahui.
raw.pt: Um dos 12 Guardiões dos Deuses e irmão mais novo do líder Sodis. Ele deu seu máximo para ajudar o irmão mais velho, eventualmente se tornando um Guardião também. Embora fosse um espadachim habilidoso, sua personalidade exageradamente séria levou muitos a pensar que ele era rígido demais. No entanto, suspeita-se de que, com experiência, ele poderia se tornar um líder melhor que o irmão. Também é sugerido em um diário antigo que ele pode ter se apaixonado por uma amiga de infância, mas não se sabe se isto procede.
raw.th: หนึ่งใน 12 ผู้พิทักษ์และน้องชายของ โซดิส ผู้นำของพวกเขา เขาพยายามอย่างสุดความสามารถเพื่อช่วยพี่ของเขาจนในที่สุดก็ได้กลายมาเป็นผู้พิทักษืด้วย แม้จะมีฝีมือในฐานะนักดาบ แต่นิสัยเอาจริงเอาจังเกินไปของเขาทำให้ทุกคนมองว่าเขาเป็นคนที่เจ้าระเบียบ อย่างไรก็ตาม ก็คาดกันว่าหากมีประสบการณ์มากพอเขาก็สามารถเป็นผู้นำที่ดีกว่าพี่ของเขาได้ และยังมีการบ่องบอกจากอนุทินที่เพิ่งค้นพบอีกว่าเขาอาจจะตกหลุมรักเพื่อในวัยเด็ก แต่ความจริงนั้นก็ยังไม่มีใครรู้
raw.vi: Một trong 12 Hộ vệ và là em trai của chỉ huy, Sodis. Anh làm hết sức để hỗ trợ anh trai mình, cuối cùng đã tự trở thành Hộ vệ. Mặc dù là một kiếm sĩ rất giỏi, tính cách quá nghiêm túc của anh khiến nhiều người thấy anh quá khắt khe. Tuy nhiên, có nghi ngờ rằng với kinh nghiệm anh có thể vượt qua người anh chỉ mình làm chỉ huy. Điều này cũng được đề xuất trong một cuốn nhật ký đã được phát hiện rằng anh có thể đã yêu một người bạn thời thơ ấu, mặc dù sự thật về điều này không được biết rõ.

id: Satu dari 12 Pelindung, yang diperintahkan untuk membunuh para pengkhianat. Tidak bisa mempercayai pengkhianatan kakaknya, hal itu ditegaskan lagi dengan dirinya yang diangkat menjadi pemimpin yang baru. Ketika dia memimpin sisa para Pelindung dari tanah para dewa, katanya wajahnya tidak bergeming ketika dia menghadapi kakaknya. Tapi, sebuah catatan sejarah menyebutkan bahwa dia menunjukkan kemarahan yang luar biasa kepada kakaknya yang mengkhianati kepercayaannya, dan bahkan menawarkan diri untuk mengejar dan mengalahkan kakaknya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50404_DESCRIPTION
desc: One of the 12 Guardians, charged with vanquishing the traitors. As unable as he was to believe in his brother's betrayel, he reaffirmed himself upon being made the Guardians' new leader. As he led the remaining Guardians from the land of the gods, it is said that once he faced his brother not a trace of distress appeared on his face. However, in certain historical texts it is written that he displayed great anger towards his brother who had betrayed his trust, and that he even volunteered to track down and defeat him.

raw.en: One of the 12 Guardians, charged with vanquishing the traitors. As unable as he was to believe in his brother's betrayel, he reaffirmed himself upon being made the Guardians' new leader. As he led the remaining Guardians from the land of the gods, it is said that once he faced his brother not a trace of distress appeared on his face. However, in certain historical texts it is written that he displayed great anger towards his brother who had betrayed his trust, and that he even volunteered to track down and defeat him.
raw.es: Un integrante de los 12 Guardianes, a quien se le encargó la destrucción de los traidores. Si bien el hecho de que su hermano se rebelara contra los dioses fue un hecho difícil de creer para él, tras ser nombrado el nuevo líder de los Guardianes, no tuvo dudas de su traición. Las historias cuentan que guió a los restantes Guardianes de la tierra divina a la batalla y que, cuando estuvo frente a frente con su hermano, no mostró el más mínimo signo de aflicción. Sin embargo, en algunos textos históricos se menciona que se lo vio realmente enfurecido con su hermano, quien había traicionado su confianza, y que incluso fue él quien se ofreció a encontrarlo y derrotarlo.

raw.pt: Um dos 12 Guardiões dos Deuses, encarregado de destruir os traidores. Mesmo incrédulo com a traição de seu irmão, ele se reafirmou ao ser nomeado o novo líder dos Guardiões. Quando ele liderou os Guardiões que restaram na terra dos deuses, dizem que não havia uma ponta de sofrimento em seu rosto ao enfrentar o próprio irmão. No entanto, alguns textos históricos indicam que ele demonstrou grande ódio do irmão que traiu sua confiança e que até se dispôs a encontrá-lo e derrotá-lo.
raw.th: หนึ่งใน 12 ผู้พิทักษ์ ผู้ได้รับหน้าที่ให้กำจัดคนทรยศ เขาไม่สามารถเชื่อได้ว่าพี่ของเขานั้นทรยศ เขายืนยันกับตัวเองอีกครั้งขณะเข้ารับตำแหน่งหัวหน้าคนใหม่ของกลุ่มผู้พิทักษ์ ขณะที่เขานำกลุ่มผู้พิทักษ์ที่เหลือออกจากดินแดนของเทพเจ้า ว่ากันว่าเมื่อเขาได้เผชิญหน้ากับพี่ชายของตน ไม่มีร่องรอยแห่งความทกข์อยู่บนใบหน้าของเขาเลย อย่างไรก็ตาม ในบางข้อความจากประวัติศาสตร์ได้เขียนเอาไว้ว่าเขาแสดงความโกรธอย่างมากใส่พี่ชายของเขาผู้ที่ได้ทรยศต่อความเชื่อใจ และเขาถึงขั้นเสนอตัวเองเพื่อเป็นคนไล่ล่าและจัดการเองอีกด้วย
raw.vi: Một trong 12 Hộ vệ, chịu trách nhiệm đánh bại những kẻ phản bội. Mặc dù không thể tin vào sự phản bội của anh trai mình, anh đã tự khẳng định mình khi được làm chỉ huy mới của đội Hộ vệ. Khi anh chỉ huy những Hộ vệ còn lại từ mảnh đất của các vị thần, người ta nói rằng anh từng đối mặt với anh trai mình không một chút đau khổ xuất hiện trên khuôn mặt anh. Tuy nhiên, trong một số văn bản lịch sử có viết rằng anh đã thể hiện sự tức giận rất lớn với anh trai mình người đã phản bội niềm tin của anh và anh thậm chí tự nguyện theo dõi và đánh bại anh.

id: Satu dari 12 Pelindung, diperintahkan untuk membunuh para pengkhianat. Pertarungan dengan kakaknya sang pengkhianat menghebat di luar dugaan semua orang. Katanya Alyut tersenyum sembari bertukar serangan mematikan dengan kakaknya. Setelah beberapa jam, Alyut memfokuskan semua yang dipunyainya ke satu serangan terakhir yang diterima Sodis secara langsung. Sodis lalu berbeicara dengan adiknya yang duduk mendengarkan, tanpa mengetahui kehadiran yang membayangi mereka.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50405_DESCRIPTION
desc: One of the 12 Guardians, charged with vanquishing the traitors. The battle with his traitor brother got more out of control than anyone had expected. It's said a smile came across Alyut's face as he and his brother exchanged death blows. After several hours, Alyut put all he had into one final blow which Sodis then took directly. Sodis then spoke to his younger brother who sat listening, unaware of the presence lurking in his own shadow.

raw.en: One of the 12 Guardians, charged with vanquishing the traitors. The battle with his traitor brother got more out of control than anyone had expected. It's said a smile came across Alyut's face as he and his brother exchanged death blows. After several hours, Alyut put all he had into one final blow which Sodis then took directly. Sodis then spoke to his younger brother who sat listening, unaware of the presence lurking in his own shadow.
raw.es: Un integrante de los 12 Guardianes, a quien se le encargó la destrucción de los traidores. La batalla con su hermano, el traidor, fue más descontrolada de lo que cualquiera hubiera imaginado. Se dice que Alyut tenía una sonrisa dibujada en el rostro mientras intercambia golpes mortales con su hermano. Tras varias horas, Alyut reunió todo el poder que le quedaba en un golpe final que impactó directamente sobre Sodis. Finalmente, Sodis habló con su hermano menor, quien lo escuchó atentamente, sin percatarse de la presencia que acechaba a su propia sombra.

raw.pt: Um dos 12 Guardiões dos Deuses, encarregado de destruir os traidores. A batalha com seu irmão traidor foi além do que muitos esperavam. Dizem que Alyut chegou a sorrir enquanto ele e seu irmão trocavam golpes potencialmente fatais. Depois de várias horas, Alyut colocou toda sua força em um golpe final, que acertou Sodis em cheio. Então Sodis falou com o irmão mais novo que simplesmente ouvia, sem saber da presença que espreitava em sua própria sombra.
raw.th: หนึ่งใน 12 ผู้พิทักษ์ ผู้ได้รับหน้าที่ให้กำจัดคนทรยศ การต่อสู้กับพี่ชายผู้ทรยศของเขาเริ่มเกินการควบคุมมากกว่าที่ทุกคนคาดไว้ ว่ากันว่ามีรอยยิ้มผุดขึ้นบนใบหน้าของอาลุทขณะที่เขากับพี่ชายได้แลกท่าไม้ตายใส่กัน หลังจากผ่านไปหลายชั่วโมง อาลุทใช้พลังที่มีทั้งหมดใส่ลงไปในการโจมตีครั้งสุดท้ายซึ่งโซดิสรับเข้าไปเต็มๆ จากนั้นโซดิสก็ได้พูดกับน้องชายผู้ที่กำลังนั่งฟังโดยที่ไม่รู้ตัวเลยว่ามีใครบางคนซ่อนอยู่ในเงาของเขาเอง
raw.vi: Một trong 12 Hộ vệ, chịu trách nhiệm đánh bại những kẻ phản bội. Trận chiến với kẻ phản bội là anh trai anh đã vượt ngoài tầm kiểm soát mà bất kỳ ai đã dự kiến. Người ta nói rằng nụ cười lướt qua khuôn mặt của Alyut khi anh và anh trai mình đưa ra đòn chí mạng. Sau nhiều giờ, Alyut đã dồn hết sức vào một đòn cuối cùng mà sau đó Sodis đã nhận trực tiếp. Sau đó, Sodis đã nói chuyện với em trai mình ngồi nghe, không biết về sự hiện diện ẩn trong cái bóng của chính anh.

id: Penyihir dari Republik La Veda, dikenal sebagai jenius dari usia muda. Mungkin karena terlalu dilindungi dalam hidupnya, dia kadang sangat egois, meskipun dia bisa bertingkah dengan baik di depan orang yang dianggapnya layak. Pemimpin pasukan berkuda Will adalah orang yang sangat disukainya, dan dia sepertinya bisa mengerti Themis. Katanya saudaranya, Aem, tidak menyukai si penyihir ini.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50413_DESCRIPTION
desc: A sorceress from the La Veda Republic, known to be a genius from an early age. Perhaps it was her protective upbringing, but she can be quite selfish, though she has the prowess to act differently in front of those she deems worthy. The cavalry leader Will was the biggest object of her fancy, and he seemed to understand her. It is said that his brother, Aem, despised the sorceress.

raw.en: A sorceress from the La Veda Republic, known to be a genius from an early age. Perhaps it was her protective upbringing, but she can be quite selfish, though she has the prowess to act differently in front of those she deems worthy. The cavalry leader Will was the biggest object of her fancy, and he seemed to understand her. It is said that his brother, Aem, despised the sorceress.
raw.es: Una hechicera de la república de La Veda que era una genio a temprana edad. Tal vez debido a que fue sobreprotegida de pequeña, Themis puede ser bastante egoísta, si bien tiene la capacidad de comportarse de forma diferente cuando está en presencia de alguien digno. Will, el líder de la caballería, era quien más le interesaba y parecía comprenderla. Se dice que su hermano, Aem, odiaba a la hechicera.

raw.pt: Uma feiticeira da República de La Veda conhecida por ser genial desde jovem. Talvez seja por conta de sua criação protegida, mas ela pode ser bem egoísta, porém tem a habilidade de agir de forma diferente na frente de quem considera merecedor. O líder da cavalaria Will era o maior objeto de seu afeto e parecia que ele a entendia. Dizem que seu irmão, Aem, desprezava a feiticeira.
raw.th: นักเวทย์หญิงจากสาธารณรัฐลาวิดา เป็นที่รู้จักในเรื่องของความอัจฉริยะมาตั้งแต่วัยเด็ก แต่เธอก็ค่อนข้างจะเห็นแก่ตัวบางทีอาจเป็นเพราะการเลี้ยงดูอย่างประคบประหงม แต่เธอก็กล้าที่จะแสดงออกในแบบที่ต่างออกไปต่อหน้าคนอ่นที่เธอเห็นค่า วิล ผู้นำกองทัพม้าเป็นคนที่เธอหลงใหลมากที่สุด และดูเหมือนว่าเขาเองก็เข้าใจเธอด้วย แต่ว่ากันว่า เอม น้องชายของเขานั้นไม่ชอบนักเวทย์หญิงคนนี้เลย
raw.vi: Một nữ phù thủy đến từ Cộng hòa LaVeda, nổi tiếng là một thiên tài từ khi còn rất nhỏ tuổi. Có lẽ chính là nhờ được nuôi dưỡng bảo vệ, nhưng nàng ta có thể khá ích kỷ, mặc dù có can đảm hành động khác thường trước những người mà nàng xét thấy đáng kính. Chỉ huy đội kỵ binh Will là đối tượng lớn nhất trong tưởng tượng của nàng ta, và ông ta dường như hiểu rõ nàng.  Người ta nói rằng huynh đệ của ông ta, Aem, đã coi thường nữ phù thủy này.

id: Penyihir jenius dari Republik La Veda, dikenal karena menyerang Kekaisaran Bariura sendirian untuk membuktikan kemampuannya. Dia ditangkap oleh ksatria Magress dan diancam berkali-kali, meskipun akhirnya dikeluarkan dari kekaisaran itu dalam keadaan hidup. Meskipun dia takut setengah mati, katanya dia tetap menendang dan berteriak dalam perjalanan ke perbatasan. Beberapa orang bahkan berkata Magress sangat terkesan akan keberaniannya dan melindunginya dari penyihir hitam kekaisaran.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50414_DESCRIPTION
desc: A genius sorceress from the La Veda Republic, known to have invaded the Bariura Empire by herself to prove her talents. There she was captured by the knight Magress and threatened repeatedly, though eventually expelled from the empire in one piece. While she was scared to tears on the inside, she is said to have been kicking and screaming the entire way to the border. Some even say that Magress was so impressed with her bravado that he personally shielded her from his empire's dark magicians.

Allí, el caballero Magress la capturó y la amenazó repetidas veces, si bien luego la echó del imperio sin un rasguño. Si bien Themis estaba asustadísima, se dice que refunfuñó y gritó durante todo el trayecto hacia la frontera. Algunos incluso dicen que Magress estaba tan impresionado por su bravura que él mismo la protegió de los magos oscuros del imperio.

raw.th: นักเวทย์หญิงอัจฉริยะสาธารณรัฐลาวิดา เป็นที่รู้จักจากการที่เธอบุกจักรวรรดิบาริอุระด้วยตัวของเธอเองเพื่อจะพิสูจน์ความสามารถของเธอ ที่นั่นเธอโดนจับโดยอัศวินมาเกรสและถูกข่มขู่ซ้ำแล้วซ้ำเล่า แต่ถึงอย่างนั้นในที่สุดเธอก็ถูกขับไล่ออกมาจากจักรวรรดิอย่างปลอดภัย ขณะที่เธอกลัวจนน้ำตาตกใน ว่ากันว่าเธอทั้งอาละวาด เตะ และร้องโวยวายตลอดเส้นทางสู่ชายแดน บางคนถึงขั้นพูดว่ามาเกรสนั้นประทับใจในความองอาจของเธอจนเขาถึงขั้นป้องกันเธอจากจอมเวทมนตร์ดำแห่งจักรวรรดิด้วยตัวของเขาเอง
raw.vi: Một nữ phù thủy thiên tài đến từ Cộng hòa LaVeda, nổi tiếng vì đã tự mình xâm lược Đế chế Bariura để chứng tỏ tài năng của mình. Tại đó, nàng ta đã bắt giữ hiệp sĩ Magress và đã nhiều lần đe dọa, mặc dù cuối cùng đã bị đánh bật hoàn toàn ra khỏi Đế chế. Trong khi hoảng sợ khóc lóc trong lòng, thì nàng ta được cho là đã kháng cự và gào thét trên suốt con đường đến biên giới. Thậm chí, một số người nói rằng Magress đã rất ấn tượng với lòng dũng cảm của nàng nên ông ta đã đích thân bảo vệ nàng trước ma thuật bóng tối của đế chế của ông ta.

id: Penyihir jenius dari Republik La Veda yang menyerang Kekaisaran Bariura sendirian. Setelah pulang, sambil meriset sihir yang dicurinya dari kekaisaran, dia mendengar bahwa ksatria Magress telah diusir. Katanya Magress melindungi mata-mata dari penyihir hitam kekaisaran dan membawanya pulang dengan selamat. Dia merasakan emosi yang sulit diungkapkan, yang membuatnya kembali ke kekaisaran, tanpa mengindahkan peringatan dari sekitarnya bahwa perang besar telah dimulai.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50415_DESCRIPTION
desc: A genius sorceress from the La Veda Republic who invaded the Bariura Empire by herself. Once home, while researching the spells she had purloined from the empire, she heard that the knight Magress had been banished. Rumor had it that he had protected a spy from the dark magicians of his empire and instead lead her away to safety. The complex emotions that rushed through her were enough to send her on her way back to the empire, ignoring the warnings of those around her as the great war began.

id: Unit tiruan dari Eriole, komandan "Pengawal Kerajaan" Kekaisaran Randall.  Meski awalnya bukan anggota masyarakat kelas atas, ia mampu naik pangkat dengan cepat selagi muda berkat kemampuan uniknya. Jago bertempur dan cerdas sesuai pangkatnya, ia disukai bawahan, masyarakat umum, dan keluarga kerajaan. Nantinya ia beraliansi dengan Aula Pemanggil Akras, lanjut memberi Noel informasi tentang dirinya dan asistennya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50444_DESCRIPTION
desc: A mock Unit modeled after Eriole, the commanding officer of the Randall Empire's "Imperial Guard." Though not initially a member of high society, he was able to quickly rise through the ranks while still quite young thanks to his unique abilities. Possessing both the combat ability and intelligence to match his rank, he had gained favor with his subordinates, the populace, and the imperial family. He would later form an alliance with the Akras Summoners' Hall, proceeding to give Noel information about himself and his aide.

Si bien en un comienzo Eriole no fue miembro de la alta sociedad, por sus habilidades únicas trepó los escalafones militares mientras aún era joven. Tenía tanto habilidades de combate como una inteligencia digna de su rango, por lo que se ganó el favor de sus subordinados, el pueblo y la familia imperial. Luego formó una alianza con el Consejo de invocadores de Akras y le brindó información a Noel sobre él mismo y su asistente.

Possuindo capacidade de combate e inteligência para combinar com seu posto, ele teve ajuda de seus subordinados, da população e da família imperial. No futuro ele formaria uma aliança com o Salão de Invocadores de Akras, passando informações sobre ele e sua ajudante para Noel.
raw.th: ยูนิตจำลองที่สร้างเลียนแบบ เอริโอเล่ หัวหน้าหน่วยประจำการของอาณาจักรแรนดัลที่เรียกกันว่า "ราชองครักษ์" แม้จะไม่ได้เป็นกลุ่มคนชั้นสูง แต่ด้วยความสามารถอันโดดเด่นทำให้เขาเลื่อนชั้นขึ้นมาได้อย่างรวดเร็วตั้งแต่ยังหนุ่ม เขามีทั้งทักษะการต่อสู้และความฉลาดที่เข้ากับยศของเขา เขาได้รับความยกย่องจากทั้งลูกน้อง ประชาชน และราชวงศ์ ในภายหลังเขาได้เข้าร่วมกับสภาซัมมอนเนอร์แห่งอาคราส เพื่อทำการมอบข้อมูลของเขาและลูกน้องให้กับโนเอล
raw.vi: Một Quái giả bắt chước theo Eriole, sỹ quan chỉ huy của đội "Cận Vệ Hoàng Đế" của Đế chế Randall. Mặc dù ban đầu không phải người thuộc tầng lớp thượng lưu, nhưng anh có thể nhanh chóng thăng qua các cấp bậc trong khi vẫn còn khá trẻ nhờ những khả năng độc đáo của mình. Sở hữu cả khả năng chiến đấu và trí thông minh phù hợp với cấp bậc của mình, anh có được sự ủng hộ của cấp dưới, công chúng và gia đình hoàng gia. Sau đó, anh đã thành lập liên minh với Đại Sảnh Người Triệu Hồi Akras, tiếp tục cung cấp cho Noel thông tin về bản thân và phụ tá của anh.

id: Unit tiruan dari Eriole, komandan "Pengawal Kerajaan" Kekaisaran Randall. Saat masih kecil, tumbuh di panti asuhan yang sama seperti asistennya, Tesla. Dendam terhadap keluarga bangsawan yang membutakan Tesla, ia membenci darah biru. Namun sisi dirinya yang ini hanya diketahui Tesla. Unit tiruan yang dibuat Noel memasukkan sisi gelap Eriole ini, agar mencapai kekuatan dahsyat. Menurut Noel, kekuatan penuh tak terkeluarkan dari Eriole ini sebanding dengan para dewa.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50445_DESCRIPTION
desc: A mock Unit modeled after Eriole, the commanding officer of the Randall Empire's "Imperial Guard." As a child, he grew up in the same orphanage as his aide, Tesla. Resenting the noble family that cost Tesla her eyesight, he came to hate those of privileged origin. However, this side of himself was one he shared with no one but Tesla. The mock Unit that Noel created included this dark side of Eriole, allowing it to reach an incredible amount of power. According to Noel, the fully unleashed power of this Eriole rivals even that of the gods'.

Quái giả mà Noel tạo ra bao gồm cả mặt tối này của Eriole, cho phép nó đạt được sức mạnh đáng kinh ngạc. Theo Noel, sức mạnh được giải phóng hoàn toàn của Eriole này có thể sánh với cả sức mạnh của các vị thần.

id: Dewi yang menipu banyak dewa lain untuk memanfaatkan mereka. Banyak dewa yang tertipu, termasuk Hakim Dosa Kajah, yang mencoba menyalahkannya atas pelanggarannya, malah dipencara akibat tuduhan palsu. Banyak pertanyaan tentang tindakan aneh Zellha, tapi banyak yang percaya dia tidak memiliki tujuan, hanya suka menipu. Meski perilaku nyentriknya menonjol, kekuatannya tidak diragukan lagi - tidak kalah dari dewa-dewa berpangkat lebih tinggi.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50473_DESCRIPTION
desc: A goddess that deceived many of the other gods in order to use them. Many gods were tricked by her, including the Judge of Sin Kajah, who trying to blame her for her transgression, got imprisoned through false charges himself. There are many questions involving Zellha's peculiar actions, but some believe that instead of having an actual purpose behind her conduct, she really just enjoyed deceiving and tricking others in itself. Though her eccentric behavior stands out the most, there is no doubt that her powers were not inferior to those of the higher ranking gods.

raw.es: Una diosa que engañó a muchos dioses para luego usarlos. Timó a una gran cantidad de deidades, incluido el Juez del pecado Kajah, que cuando intentó culparla de sus transgresiones, terminó en un calabozo acusado por delitos que no había cometido. Hay muchas preguntas sobre el peculiar comportamiento de Zellha, pero algunos creen que en vez de tener un propósito real detrás de sus acciones, a ella solo le interesaba el hecho de engañar y timar a los demás. A pesar de que su excéntrico carácter era lo más llamativo de ella, no hay duda que sus poderes no eran inferiores a los de los dioses de alto rango.

Banyak dewa yang tertipu, termasuk Hakim Dosa Kajah, yang mencoba menyalahkannya atas pelanggarannya, malah dipencara akibat tuduhan palsu. Banyak pertanyaan tentang tindakan aneh Zellha, tapi banyak yang percaya dia tidak memiliki tujuan, hanya suka menipu. Meski perilaku nyentriknya menonjol, kekuatannya tidak diragukan lagi - tidak kalah dari dewa-dewa berpangkat lebih tinggi.
raw.pt: Uma deusa que enganou muitos dos outros deuses, para usá-los. Muitos deuses foram enganados por ela, incluindo o Juiz de Sin Kajah, que ao tentar condená-la pela sua transgressão, acabou preso sob falsas acusações. Existem muitas perguntas sobre as ações peculiares de Zellha, mas alguns acreditam que ao invés de ter um motivo para sua conduta, ela simplesmente gostava de enganar e ludibriar os outros. Embora comportamento excêntrico seja o maior destaque, não há dúvida de que seus poderes não eram inferiores aos de deuses de maior escalão.
raw.th: เทพธิดาที่หลอกลวงเทพเจ้าองค์อื่นๆ มากมายเพื่อที่จะใช้งานพวกนั้น เทพเจ้าหลายองค์ถูกหลอกโดยเธอรวมถึงผู้พิพากษาแห่งความผิดบาปคาจาห์ ผู้ที่พยายามจะโทษเธอจากพฤติกรรมที่ไม่เหมาะสม จนทำให้เขาถูกคุมขังจากความผิดที่เขาไม่ได้กระทำ มีคำถามมากมายที่เกี่ยวข้องกับการกระทำแปลกๆ ของเซลฮา แต่บางคนเชื่อว่าเธอไม่ได้มีจุดประสงค์ที่แน่นอนในเบื้องหลังการกระทำของเธอ เธอแค่สนุกกับการหลอกลวงและหลอกใช้คนอื่นๆ  แม้ว่าพฤติกรรมประหลาดของเธอจะโดดเด่นมากที่สุด แต่ไม่เป็นที่กังขาว่าพลังของเธอนั้นไม่ได้ด้อยกว่าของเทพเจ้าระดับสูงกว่าเลย
raw.vi: Một nữ thần đã lừa dối nhiều vị thần khác để lợi dụng họ. Nhiều vị thần đã bị cô lừa, bao gồm cả Thẩm phán Sin Kajah, người cố gắng buộc tội cô vì những vi phạm của cô, bị tống giam mặc dù bị oan. Có nhiều câu hỏi liên quan đến hành động của Zellha, nhưng một số tin rằng thay vì có mục đích thực sự đằng sau hành vi của cô, thì cô thực sự chỉ thích bản thân việc lừa gạt những người khác. Mặc dù những hành vi lập dị của cô là nổi bật hơn hết, nhưng sức mạnh của cô không hề thua kém các vị thần có thứ hạng cao là điều chẳng phải nghi ngờ.

id: Dewi yang ingin menipu banyak dewa lain untuk memanfaatkan mereka. Suka-suka, ia pergi ke Kekaisaran Bariura dan berhubungan dekat dengan penyihir gelap. Namun si penyihir berkhianat dan memakai si dewi untuk mendapatkan pengetahuan dan kekuatannya. Marah, Zellha mencoba memakai dewa-dewa berpangkat tinggi untuk balas dendam, tapi para dewa tidak mengalah dan malah tertangkap. Apa pun niat Zellha, setelah itu ia memutuskan untuk menghancurkan semua manusia, mengambil inisiatif dengan pergi ke medan perang.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50474_DESCRIPTION
desc: A goddess that wanted to deceive the other gods in order to use them. On a whim, she made her way to the Bariura Empire where she grew close to a dark magician. However, this magician turned the tables on her, using the goddess to gain her knowledge and power. Enraged, Zellha tried to use other higher ranking gods to seek revenge, but contrary to her expectations, the gods didn't budge and were captured instead. After that, regardless of her own intentions, she decided to destroy all humans, taking the initiative by heading towards the battlefield.

raw.en: A goddess that wanted to deceive the other gods in order to use them. On a whim, she made her way to the Bariura Empire where she grew close to a dark magician. However, this magician turned the tables on her, using the goddess to gain her knowledge and power. Enraged, Zellha tried to use other higher ranking gods to seek revenge, but contrary to her expectations, the gods didn't budge and were captured instead. After that, regardless of her own intentions, she decided to destroy all humans, taking the initiative by heading towards the battlefield.
raw.es: Una diosa que quería engañar a los otros dioses para usarlos. Por un capricho viajó hacia el imperio Bariura donde generó una amistad con un mago oscuro. Sin embargo, este mago la sorprendió y comenzó a usarla para obtener poder y conocimiento. Enfurecida, Zellha intentó usar otros dioses de alto rango para buscar venganza, pero al contrario de lo que ella esperaba, los otros dioses ni se mosquearon, y a Zellha la terminaron capturando. Dejando de lado sus propias intenciones, Zellha decidió destruir a todos los humanos y tomar la iniciativa lanzándose al campo de batalla.

raw.pt: Uma deusa que queria ludibriar os outros deuses para usá-los. Do nada, ela partiu para o Império Bariura, onde se aproximou a um mago sombrio. Porém, esse mago virou o jogo, usando a deusa para obter seu conhecimento e poder. Enfurecida, Zellha tentou usar os outros deuses mais poderosos para sua vingança, mas ao contrário de suas expectativas, os deuses não cederam e foram capturados. Independente de suas intenções, depois disso ela decidiu destruir todos os humanos, tomando a iniciativa ao se dirigir ao campo de batalha.
raw.th: เทพธิดาที่หลอกเทพเจ้าองค์อื่นๆ เพื่อที่จะใช้งานพวกนั้น ด้วยความคิดเพ้อฝันเธอได้มุ่งหน้าไปยังจักรวรรดิบาริอุระ ที่เธอได้มีความใกล้ชิดมากขึ้นกับจอมเวทย์มนต์ดำ อย่างไรก็ตามจอมเวทย์ผู้นี้กลับเป็นผู้หลอกใช้เธอเสียเอง โดยหลอกใช้เทพธิดาเพื่อต้องการความรู้และพลังของเธอ ด้วยความโกรธเซลฮาได้พยายามใช้เทพเจ้าระดับสูงองค์อื่นๆ เพื่อที่จะหาทางแก้แค้น แต่ผิดไปจากความคาดหวังของเธอ เมื่อเทพเจ้ากลับไม่ยอมเคลื่อนไหวและเธอกลับถูกจับแทนเสียเองโดยไม่คำนึงถึงความตั้งใจของเธอ หลังจากนั้นเธอจึงตัดสินใจที่จะทำลายมนุษย์ทุกคน เริ่มต้นโดยการมุ่งหน้าไปสู่สนามรบ
raw.vi: Một nữ thần muốn lừa gạt vị thần khác để lợi dụng họ. Một phút bốc đồng, cô tự mình tới Đế chế Bariura nơi cô đã lớn lên gần một pháp sư hắc ám. Tuy nhiên, pháp sư này đã tương kế tựu kế với cô, bằng cách lợi dụng nữ thần này để có được kiến thức và sức mạnh của cô. Tức giận, Zellha đã cố gắng lợi dụng các vị thần có thứ hạng cao hơn khác để tìm cách trả thù, nhưng trái với mong đợi của cô, các vị thần không lay chuyển được tình thế mà thay vào đó đều bị bắt. Bất chấp mục đích, sau đó cô đã quyết định hủy diệt tất cả loài người, bằng cách chủ động tiên phong ra chiến trường.

id: Dewi yang ingin menipu banyak dewa lain untuk memanfaatkan mereka. Dengan keinginan menghancurkan kemanusiaan yang berbeda-beda levelnya dari dewa ke dewa, Zellha pergi ke kekaisaran dan ditipu oleh penyihir gelap. Yang menghentikannya kali ini adalah dewa yang sudah dia tipu sekali - Kajah. Terbakar oleh dendam pribadi terhadap si dewi, Kajah berhasil menghentikannya, membuat Zellha lari dengan marah. "Terima kasih atas gangguanmu, lebih banyak manusia yang menderita daripada yang perlu menderita," itulah perkataan Zellha.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50475_DESCRIPTION
desc: A goddess that wanted to deceive the other gods in order to use them. With the desire for the destruction of humanity varying from god to god, she headed towards the empire where she herself was tricked by a dark magician. However, the one to stop her this time was a god that had already been fooled by her once--Kajah. Fueled by his personal grudge against the goddess, he was able to stop her, making her flee angrily from the scene. "Thanks to your intrusion, more humans suffered than was necessary." were the only words she left behind.

Sin embargo, quien la detuvo esta vez fue un dios a quien ella ya había engañado: Kajah. Embriagado por su odio personal hacia la diosa, Kajah pudo detenerla y logró que se fuera corriendo desde el campo de batalla enfurecida. "Gracias a tu intromisión, los humanos han sufrido más de lo necesario". Esas fueron las únicas palabras que dejó al irse.

raw.pt: Uma deusa que queria enganar os outros deuses para usá-los. Com o desejo para a destruição da humanidade variando entre cada divindade, ela partiu em direção ao império onde havia sido enganada por um mago sombrio. Porém, quem a impediu dessa vez foi um deus que já havia sido enganado por ela: Kajah. Movido pelo seu ódio contra a deusa, ele conseguiu impedi-la, fazendo com que ela fugisse raivosamente. “Graças ao seu intrometimento, mais humanos sofreram do que seria necessário.” foram suas únicas palavras.
raw.th: เทพธิดาที่หลอกเทพเจ้าองค์อื่นๆ เพื่อที่จะใช้งานพวกนั้น ด้วยความปรารถนาที่จะทำลายล้างมวลมนุษย์ที่แตกต่างกันไปในเทพเจ้าแต่ละตน เธอได้มุ่งหน้าสู่จักรวรรดิ์ที่ซึ่งเธอถูกหลอกโดยจอมเวทย์มนต์ดำ อย่างไรก็ตามคนที่มาหยุดยั้งเธอครั้งนี้คือเทพเจ้าที่เคยถูกเธอหลอกมาแล้วครั้งหนึ่งคาจาห์ สาเหตุมาจากความไม่พอใจส่วนตัวของเขากับเทพธิดาองค์นี้ เขาสามารถที่จะหยุดเธอเอาไว้ได้ และทำให้เธอหนีไปด้วยความโกรธ "ขอบใจนะที่เจ้ามาขวางไว้ มนุษย์อีกมากจะต้องทรมานมากกว่าที่ควรจะเป็น" นั่นเป็นคำพูดเดียวที่เธอทิ้งไว้ก่อนจากไป
raw.vi: Một nữ thần muốn lừa gạt vị thần khác để lợi dụng họ. Với mong muốn hủy diệt loài người bằng cách biến đổi giữa các vị thần, cô hướng về phía đế chế nơi bản thân cô đã bị lừa bởi một phù thủy hắc ám. Tuy nhiên, người đã ngăn cô lúc này là một vị thần đã từng bị cô lừa--Kajah. Bị thúc đẩy bởi lòng hận thù cá nhân của anh với nữ thần, anh có thể ngăn cô, khiến cô giận dữ lẩn mất. "Nhờ sự xâm phạm của ngươi, nhiều con người sẽ phải đau đớn hơn mức cần thiết." là những lời duy nhất cô để lại.

id: Jauh sebelum perang antara manusia dan dewa, ada malaikat mengerikan yang mengatur penghakiman. Tidak membedakan antara dewa dan manusia, dia akan muncul di depan pendosa dengan tiga wajahnya dan memberikan penghakimannya. Wajah di kanannya melambangkan kejahatan, dan wajah di kirinya melakukan pembelaan. Katanya wajah terakhir yang ada di tengah memberikan penghakiman terakhir, dan kalau ditemukan bersalah, mereka akan dihakimi dengan serangan tanpa belas kasih. Meskipun adil, menghakimi orang yang melanggar tanpa memberi kesempatan bertobat membuatnya ditakuti oleh manusia, dan juga oleh para dewa. Dia disebut sebagai "Malaikat Hitam."
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50483_DESCRIPTION
desc: Long before the battle between the humans and the gods, there was an abominable angel who passed judgment. Not discriminating between gods nor humans, he would appear before sinners with his three faces and pass his sentence. His right face represents crimes, and his left represents a defense. It is said that the last face in the middle passes the final sentence, and if the prosecuted is found guilty, it is judged by a merciless attack. Though fair, judging trespassers without a chance of salvation made him feared by the humans, as well as by the gods. He was called the "Black Angel."

raw.en: Long before the battle between the humans and the gods, there was an abominable angel who passed judgment. Not discriminating between gods nor humans, he would appear before sinners with his three faces and pass his sentence. His right face represents crimes, and his left represents a defense. It is said that the last face in the middle passes the final sentence, and if the prosecuted is found guilty, it is judged by a merciless attack. Though fair, judging trespassers without a chance of salvation made him feared by the humans, as well as by the gods. He was called the "Black Angel."
raw.es: Mucho antes de que se librara la batalla entre humanos y dioses, existía un ángel abominable que impartía justicia. No hacía diferencias entre humanos y dioses, y aparecía frente a los pecadores con sus tres caras. La cara derecha representa los crímenes y la izquierda la defensa. Se dice que la cara central es la que imparte el juicio final. En caso de que al procesado se lo encuentre culpable, será juzgado con un ataque sin piedad. A pesar de ser justo, los intrusos sin posibilidad de sobrevivir hicieron que tanto los humanos como los dioses le tuvieran miedo. Se lo solía llamar "El ángel negro".

Tidak membedakan antara dewa dan manusia, dia akan muncul di depan pendosa dengan tiga wajahnya dan memberikan penghakimannya. Wajah di kanannya melambangkan kejahatan, dan wajah di kirinya melakukan pembelaan. Katanya wajah terakhir yang ada di tengah memberikan penghakiman terakhir, dan kalau ditemukan bersalah, mereka akan dihakimi dengan serangan tanpa belas kasih. raw.pt: Muito antes da batalha entre humanos e deuses, havia um anjo abominável que julgava a todos. Sem discriminar deuses ou humanos, ele aparecia diante de pecadores com suas três faces para aplicar sua sentença. Sua face direita representa os crimes e a esquerda, uma defesa. Dizem que a face do meio é que dá a sentença final e, se o acusado for considerado culpado, será condenado com um ataque impiedoso. Embora fosse justo, o julgamento de intrusos que não tinham a menor chance de salvação o tornou temido por humanos e também por deuses. Ele era chamado de “Anjo Negro”.
raw.th: นานมาแล้วก่อนการต่อสู้ระหว่างมนุษย์กับเทพเจ้า  มีฑูตสวรรค์ที่น่ารังเกียจผู้ส่งมอบคำพิพากษา โดยไม่แบ่งแยกระหว่างมนุษย์หรือเทพเจ้า เขาจะปรากฎตัวต่อหน้าผู้ผิดบาปพร้อมกับหน้าทั้งสามและส่งต่อคำพูดของเขา ใบหน้าขวาของเขาเป็นตัวแทนอาชญากรรม และด้านซ้ายของเขาแทนสิ่งแก้ต่าง ว่ากันว่าใบหน้าสุดท้ายตรงกลางส่งมอบคำพิพากษาสุดท้าย และถ้าผู้ถูกกล่าวหาถูกตัดสินว่าทำผิด ก็จะถูกพิพากษาด้วยการโจมตีอย่างไร้ความปราณี แม้จะยุติธรรม แต่การตัดสินผู้ทำผิดโดยไม่มอบโอกาสในการไถ่บาปทำให้นั้น เป็นที่หวาดกลัวจากทั้งมนุษย์และเทพเจ้าด้วยเช่นกัน เขาถูกเรียกว่า "ฑูตสวรรค์สีดำ"
raw.vi: Từ lâu trước cuộc chiến giữa con người và các vị thần, đã có một thiên thần xấu xa vượt qua được ngày phán quyết. Chẳng phân biệt giữa các vị thần hay con người, hắn sẽ xuất hiện ngay trước mặt những kẻ tội lỗi với ba khuôn mặt của mình và đưa ra phán quyết. Mặt bên phải của hắn kể ra các tội ác, và mặt bên trái đưa ra lời biện hộ. Người ta nói rằng khuôn mặt cuối ở giữa sẽ đưa ra phán quyết sau cùng, và nếu bị kết tội, họ sẽ bị phán xử bằng một cuộc tấn công tàn nhẫn. Mặc dù công bằng, việc phán xử những kẻ mắc tội mà chẳng có cơ hội cứu rỗi nào cũng khiến hắn lo sợ con người, cũng như là các vị thần. Hắn được gọi là "Thiên thần đen".

id: Jauh sebelum perang antara manusia dan dewa, ada malaikat mengerikan yang mengatur penghakiman. Dia tidak peduli hal yang lain kecuali sidangnya, membuatnya tidak mempunyai pikiran maupun perasaan, tapi terus memberikan penghakiman secara adil, tidak peduli yang dihakimi adalah manusia atau bukan. Kaisar Dewa Besar mengakui kekuatan dewa ini, dan memberinya peran baru yang sesuai dengan kekuatannya. Hamba yang muda nantinya akan mendapatkan peran ini di kemudian hari, tapi ini hanyalah spekulasi. Dia juga mendapat tugas untuk menghakimi malaikat yang telah memberontak melawan para dewa.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50484_DESCRIPTION
desc: Long before the battle between the humans and the gods, there was an abominable angel who administered judgment. He cared for nothing but his trials, leaving him without feelings nor thoughts, but continued to pass judgment fairly, regardless of whether the prosecuted was human or not. The Great God Emperor acknowledged this god's power, and appointed him to a new role befitting of his abilities. A young servant would inherit this role later on, but this is only a speculation. He also gained the responsibility of judging those angels who had turned against the gods.

He cared for nothing but his trials, leaving him without feelings nor thoughts, but continued to pass judgment fairly, regardless of whether the prosecuted was human or not. The Great God Emperor acknowledged this god's power, and appointed him to a new role befitting of his abilities. A young servant would inherit this role later on, but this is only a speculation. He also gained the responsibility of judging those angels who had turned against the gods.
raw.es: Mucho antes de que se librara la batalla entre humanos y dioses, existía un ángel abominable que impartía justicia. Solo le importaban los juicios, por lo que carecía de sensaciones o pensamientos, y continuaba impartiendo justicia equitativa, sin importar si el procesado era humano o no. El gran emperador divino reconoció el poder de este dios y lo designó en un rol apto para sus capacidades. Un joven sirviente se quedaría con ese rol más adelante, pero eso es solo una especulación. También comenzó a hacerse responsable de ajusticiar a los ángeles que habían traicionado a los dioses.
raw.id: Jauh sebelum perang antara manusia dan dewa, ada malaikat mengerikan yang mengatur penghakiman. Dia tidak peduli hal yang lain kecuali sidangnya, membuatnya tidak mempunyai pikiran maupun perasaan, tapi terus memberikan penghakiman secara adil, tidak peduli yang dihakimi adalah manusia atau bukan. Kaisar Dewa Besar mengakui kekuatan dewa ini, dan memberinya peran baru yang sesuai dengan kekuatannya. Hamba yang muda nantinya akan mendapatkan peran ini di kemudian hari, tapi ini hanyalah spekulasi. Dia juga mendapat tugas untuk menghakimi malaikat yang telah memberontak melawan para dewa.
raw.pt: Muito antes da batalha entre humanos e deuses, havia um anjo abominável que realizava julgamentos. Ele não se importava com mais nada além de seus julgamentos, deixando-o sem sentimentos ou pensamentos, mas mantendo a justiça na sentença, independente da natureza do acusado. O Grande Deus Imperador tomou conhecimento do poder desse deus e atribuiu uma nova função a ele, função essa que fazia uso das habilidades do deus. Um jovem servo herdaria sua função no futuro, mas isso não passa de especulação. Ele também recebeu a incumbência de julgar os anjos que se viraram contra os deuses.
raw.th: นานมาแล้วก่อนการต่อสู้ระหว่างมนุษย์กับเทพเจ้า มีฑูตสวรรค์ที่น่ารังเกียจผู้ทำหน้าที่พิพากษา เขาไม่สนใจสิ่งอื่นใดนอกจากการพิพากษาของเขา ทำให้เขาไม่มีความคิดหรือรู้สึก แต่ยังคงมอบการตัดสินต่อไปอย่างยุติธรรม โดยไม่สนว่าผู้ที่ถูกพิพากษาจะเป้นมนุษย์หรือไม่ใช่ก็ตาม จักรพรรดิเทพเจ้าผู้ยิ่งใหญ่รู้ถึงพลังของเทพตนนี้ และได้มอบหมายบทบาทใหม่ที่เหมาะสมกับความสามารถของเขา สาวกหนุ่มจะสืบทอดบทบาทนี้ในภายหลัง แต่นี่เป็นเพียงการคาดเดา เขายังได้รับหน้าที่รับผิดชอบในการพิพากษาเหล่าฑูตสวรรค์ที่หันมาต่อต้านเทพเจ้าด้วย
raw.vi: Từ lâu trước cuộc chiến giữa con người và các vị thần, đã có một thiên thần xấu xa cai quản việc phán quyết. Hắn chẳng quan tâm đến gì ngoài việc xét xử của mình, chẳng hề có cảm xúc hay suy nghĩ gì, nhưng vẫn tiếp tục đưa ra bản án một cách công bằng, bất kể kẻ bị kết tội có phải là con người hay không. Đại Thần Hoàng đã thừa nhận sức mạnh của vị thần này, và bổ nhiệm hắn vào vai trò mới để củng cố quyền hành của mình. Một tên đầy tớ trẻ sẽ kế thừa vai trò đó sau này, nhưng đây chỉ là suy đoán. Hắn cũng có được trách nhiệm phán quyết những thiên thần đã quay lưng chống lại các vị thần.

id: Jauh sebelum perang antara manusia dan dewa, ada malaikat mengerikan yang mengatur penghakiman. Selagi dia menghakimi dan menghukum satu demi satu makhluk, dia menjadi lebih kuat, tapi juga mulai bingung akan pikiran dan emosinya yang semakin menumpuk. Perlahan, dia mulai kehilangan kekuatan untuk menghukum yang lain, dan katanya dilepaskan dari tugasnya oleh Kaisar Dewa Besar, meskipun tidak ada bukti yang mendukung cerita ini. Ada cerita lain yang mencoba menjelaskan kemungkinan bahwa setelah malaikan hitam ini menjadi lemah dia menerima penghakiman untuk dirinya sendiri.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50485_DESCRIPTION
desc: Long before the battle between the humans and the gods, there was a god who administered judgment. As he judged and convicted one being after another, he grew stronger, but simultaneously began to feel confused by his countless thoughts and emotions. Gradually, he began to lose the power to convict others, and is said to have been relieved of his post by the Great God Emperor, though there's no proof to substantiate this. There is yet another tale which explores the possibility that shortly after the dark angel weakened he underwent the sword of judgment himself.

Gradually, he began to lose the power to convict others, and is said to have been relieved of his post by the Great God Emperor, though there's no proof to substantiate this. There is yet another tale which explores the possibility that shortly after the dark angel weakened he underwent the sword of judgment himself.
raw.es: Mucho antes de que se librara la batalla entre humanos y dioses, existía un dios que impartía justicia. Mientras juzgaba y condenaba un ser tras otro, Azael se hizo más fuerte, aunque, al mismo tiempo, comenzó a sentirse confundido por una cantidad incontable de emociones y pensamientos. Gradualmente empezó a perder el poder para juzgar a otros. Se dice que el gran emperador divino lo alejó de su puesto, aunque no hay ninguna prueba fehaciente que ayude a comprobarlo. También hay quienes dicen que poco tiempo después de haberse debilitado, el mismísimo ángel fue juzgado por el filo de la justicia.

raw.pt: Muito antes da batalha entre humanos e deuses, havia um deus que realizava julgamentos. Enquanto ele julgava e condenava um ser atrás do outro, ele ficou mais forte mas, ao mesmo tempo, começou a se sentir confuso por seus inúmeros pensamentos e sentimentos. Com o tempo ele começou a perder o poder de condenar os outros e dizem que ele foi retirado de sua função pelo Grande Deus Imperador, embora não haja evidências para comprovar isto. Ainda há outro conto que explora a possibilidade de que, pouco depois de enfraquecer, o próprio anjo negro se submeteu à espada do julgamento.
raw.th: นานมาแล้วก่อนการต่อสู้ระหว่างมนุษย์กับเทพเจ้า มีเทพเจ้าผู้ทำหน้าที่พิพากษา ขณะที่เขาพิพากษาและตัดสินสิ่งมีชีวิตไปเรื่อยๆ เขาก็เติบโตแข็งแกร่งขึ้น แต่ก็เริ่มรู้สึกสับสนไปพร้อมๆ กันกับอารมณ์และความคิดมากมายนับไม่ถ้วนทีละนิด เขาเริ่มที่จะสูญเสียพลังในการตัดสินผู้อื่น และว่ากันว่าถูกปลดจากหน้าที่ของเขาโดยจักรพรรดิเทพเจ้าผู้ยิ่งใหญ่ แม้ว่าจะไม่มีหลักฐานมาสนับสนุนในเรื่องนี้ แต่ยังคงมีเรื่องเล่าซึ่งเปิดเผยความเป็นไปได้ว่า ไม่นานหลังจากที่ฑูตสวรรค์ดำอ่อนแอลง เขาต้องเผชิญหน้ากับดาบแห่งการพิพากษาด้วยตัวเอง
raw.vi: Từ lâu trước cuộc chiến giữa con người và các vị thần, đã có một vị thần cai quản việc phán quyết. Khi ông phán xét và kết án hết người này đến người khác, ông đã mạnh mẽ hơn, nhưng đồng thời bắt đầu cảm thấy bối rối bởi vô số những suy nghĩ và cảm xúc của mình. Dần dần, ông bắt đầu mất đi sức mạnh để buộc tội những người khác, và được cho là đã bị Đại Thần Hoàng miễn nhiệm, mặc dù không có bằng cứ chứng minh điều này. Còn một câu chuyện khác khám phá ra khả năng đó rằng ngay sau khi thiên thần bóng tối bị suy yếu hắn đã tự mình chịu đựng thanh kiếm phán xét.

id: Pengelana dan penjelajah dunia terkenal, ayah dari Alma. Dikenal karena kekuatannya, dia meninggalkan jejaknya di dunia selagi dia berkelana dengan kapak kesayangannya, mengalahkan beast yang paling ganas sekalipun dalam satu pukulan. Tapi, karena kekuatannya yang luar biasa, kapaknya rusak setelah lama dipakai. Dia juga terkenal dengan cerita yang dibacakannya kepada anak-anak di kota yang dikunjunginya. Anaknya Alma juga termasuk di antaranya, mendengarkan petualangan ayahnya berkali-kali.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50503_DESCRIPTION
desc: A famous adventurer and world traveler, and father to Alma. Known for his great strength, he left his footmarks around the globe while he explored with his beloved axe in hand, defeating even the most atrocious beasts with one blow. However, due to his ridiculous strength, his axe broke after continuous use. He is also famous for sharing his stories with the local children of the towns he visited. His daughter Alma was also included among them, listening to her father's exploits over and over again.

raw.en: A famous adventurer and world traveler, and father to Alma. Known for his great strength, he left his footmarks around the globe while he explored with his beloved axe in hand, defeating even the most atrocious beasts with one blow. However, due to his ridiculous strength, his axe broke after continuous use. He is also famous for sharing his stories with the local children of the towns he visited. His daughter Alma was also included among them, listening to her father's exploits over and over again.
raw.es: Padre de Alma. Famoso aventurero y errante de mundos. Conocido por su potente fuerza, regó el mundo con sus huellas y exploró junto a su amada hacha, derrotando incluso a las bestias más atroces de un solo golpe. Sin embargo, debido a su ridícula violencia, rompió su hacha después de tanto uso. También es famoso por compartir sus historias con los jóvenes de las ciudades que visita. Su hija Alma estaba incluida en ellos, y escuchaba las hazañas de su padre una y otra vez.
raw.id: Pengelana dan penjelajah dunia terkenal, ayah dari Alma. Dikenal karena kekuatannya, dia meninggalkan jejaknya di dunia selagi dia berkelana dengan kapak kesayangannya, mengalahkan beast yang paling ganas sekalipun dalam satu pukulan. Tapi, karena kekuatannya yang luar biasa, kapaknya rusak setelah lama dipakai. Dia juga terkenal dengan cerita yang dibacakannya kepada anak-anak di kota yang dikunjunginya. Anaknya Alma juga termasuk di antaranya, mendengarkan petualangan ayahnya berkali-kali.
raw.pt: Um famoso aventureiro e viajante, pai de Alma. Conhecido por sua grande força, ele deixou suas pegadas ao redor do mundo enquanto o explorava empunhando seu amado machado e derrotando até as feras mais perigosas com um só golpe. No entanto, devido a sua força absurda, seu machado quebrou com o uso contínuo. Ele também é famoso por compartilhar suas histórias com as crianças dos locais que ele visitava. Sua filha, Alma, também estava entre elas e ouvia as histórias do pai o tempo todo.
raw.th: นักผจญภัยที่มีชื่อเสียงและเดินทางไปรอบโลกและเป็นพ่อของอัลม่า เป็นที่รู้จักจากพลังที่ยิ่งใหย่ของเขา เขาทิ้งรอยเท้าเอาไว้อยู่ทั่วโลกขณะที่ออกสำรวจพร้อมกับขวานสุดรักในมือ เอาชนะแม้แต่สัตว์ที่ดุร้ายที่สุดด้วยการโจมตีเพียงครั้งเดียว อย่างไรก็ตามเนื่องจากพลังที่มากจนเกินไป ขวานของเขาจึงพังลงหลังจากถูกใช้มาอย่างต่อเนื่อง เขายังโด่งดังจากเรื่องเล่าของเขากับเด็กๆ ท้องถิ่นในเมืองที่ได้ผ่านไป บุตรสาวของเขาอัลม่าก็เป็นหนึ่งในนั้นด้วย ที่ได้ยินเรื่องการสำรวจของพ่อเธอครั้งแล้วครั้งเล่า
raw.vi: Một nhà thám hiểm và nhà du lịch thế giới nổi tiếng, và là cha của Alma. Được biết đến bởi sức mạnh tuyệt vời của mình, ông đã để lại dấu chân mình trên khắp trái đất trong khi khám phá mọi nơi bằng chiếc rìu yêu quý của mình trong tay, thậm chí đánh gục những con quái vật tàn bạo nhất chỉ bằng một cú đánh. Tuy nhiên, bởi sức mạnh khủng khiếp của mình, chiếc rìu của ông đã vỡ nát sau khi sử dụng liên tục. Ông cũng nổi tiếng bởi việc chia sẻ những câu chuyện của mình với lũ trẻ nơi các thị trấn ông đã ghé qua. Con gái Alma cũng nằm trong số đó, hay lắng nghe những khám phá của cha mình hết lần này đến lần khác.

id: Pengelana dan penjelajah dunia terkenal. Katanya dia mengalahkan musuhnya di medan perang dengan gagah, dan ketegasan dan kewaspadaannya adalah yang paling top di dunia sehingga dia bisa menghindari semua jebakan hanya dalam hitungan detik. Dalam perjalanannya, gadis pelajar berkaca mata memberi tahu tentang menara penghancur yang dorman di sebuah reruntuhan kuno. Dia lalu memutuskan untuk pergi ke sana dan menyegelnya. Tapi, dia khawatir apa yang akan terjadi dengan anaknya. Setelah istrinya bersikeras untuk ikut, mereka pergi sebagai keluarga.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_50504_DESCRIPTION
desc: A famous adventurer and world traveler. It is said that he heroically defeated his enemies on the battlefield, and that his decisiveness and awareness were so top class that he was able to avoid any kind of trap in mere seconds. During his travels, a spectacled scholar girl told him about a great destructive power that lay dormant within some ancient ruins. He then decided to head in that direction in order to seal it. However, he was worried about what would become of his daughter. After his wife pleaded that she take them with him, they set off on their journey as a family.
