id: Ksatria dari Kekaisaran Bariura yang hancur total, dia nantinya menjadi satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Sebagai anak pemimpin pasukan berkuda, dari kecil dia sudah tahu keinginan kaisar untuk menyatukan benua. Dia bergabung dengan pasukan berkuda pada usia 16 tahun dengan keinginan mendapatkan keahlian yang cukup untuk mengalahkan semua yang menghalanginya. Bakatnya tumbuh pesat dan dia segera dicalonkan untuk promosi.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60011_DESCRIPTION
desc: A knight from the utterly devastated Bariura Empire, he later became one of the Six Heroes. As a cavalry leader's son, from childhood he knew of the empire's wish of unifying the continent. He joined the cavalry at 16 intent on gaining the skills necessary to defeat anything that stood in his way. His talent grew quickly and he was soon considered for promotion.

Se unió al ejército con 16 años con la intención de derrotar a quien se pusiera en su camino. En poco tiempo demostró su talento y fue ascendido.

raw.pt: Um cavaleiro do Império devastado de Bariura, ele veio a se tornar um dos Seis Heróis. Como filho de um líder da cavalaria, desde a infância ele sabia do intuito do império de unificar o continente. Ele se alistou na cavalaria aos 16 para adquirir habilidade para derrotar tudo que ficasse em seu caminho. Seu talento cresceu rapidamente e logo ele foi cogitado para uma promoção.
raw.th: อัศวินจากจักรวรรดิบาริอุละที่ถูกทำลายอย่างสิ้นเชิง ภายหลังเขาได้เป็นหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษ ในฐานะที่เป็นบุตรชายของหัวหน้ากองลาดตระเวณ เขารับรู้ความปรารถนาของจักรวรรดิที่จะรวบรวมแผ่นดินมาตั้งแต่ยังเด็ก  เขาเข้าร่วมกองทัพลาดตระเวณตั้งแต่อายุ 16 และมีความตั้งใจจะได้รับทักษะที่จำเป็นสำหรับเอาชนะใครก็ตามที่เข้ามาขวางทางของเขา ความสามารถของเขาพัฒนาอย่างรวดเร็วและไม่นานก็ได้รับพิจารณาเลื่อนขั้น
raw.vi: Một hiệp sĩ tới từ Đế quốcBariura bị tàn phá, sau này trở thành một trong sáu vị anh hùng. Là con trai của một nhà lãnh đạo kỵ binh, từ lúc còn bé, chàng biết mong muốn của đế quốc là thống nhất lục địa. Chàng gia nhập kỵ binh lúc 16 tuổi với ý định có được những kỹ năng cần thiết để đánh bại bất cứ thứ gì trên con đường chàng đi. Tài năng của chàng phát triển nhanh chóng và đế quốc sớm đã cân nhắc tới việc đào tạo phát triển chàng.

id: Ksatria dari Kekaisaran Bariura yang hancur total, dia nantinya menjadi satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Gosipnya dia akan menjadi pemimpin pasukan berkuda berikutnya, tapi ketika dia kalah dari ayahnya, dia meninggalkan keluarga dan kekaisaran. Dia berlatih keras, menggunakan kemarahannya untuk meningkatkan ilmunya. Dia bahkan mampu menembus zirah berat. Gosip itu akhirnya sampai ke ibu kota dan membuat marah para ksatria yang ditinggalkannya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60012_DESCRIPTION
desc: A knight from the utterly devastated Bariura Empire, he later became one of the Six Heroes. Rumor was he'd be the next cavalry leader, but when he lost to his father, he left his family and the empire. He trained hard, using his anger to hone his skills. He was even able to pierce heavy armor. Rumors of him reached the capital and angered the knights whom he abandoned.

Siguió entrenando y su furia se convirtió en su talento. Era capaz de destruir hasta la más férrea coraza. Cuentan que volvió a la capital solo para enfurecer a quienes había abandonado.

raw.vi: Một hiệp sĩ tới từ đế quốc Bariura bị tàn phá, sau này trở thành một trong vị sáu anh hùng. Người ta đồn rằng chàng muốn làm người lãnh đạo kỵ binh kế nhiệm, nhưng khi cha mất, chàng rời bỏ gia đình và đế quốc. Chàng luyện tập nghiêm khắc, dùng sự tức giận của mình để trau dồi kỹ năng. Thậm chí chàng còn có thể xuyên thủng áo giáp nặng. Tin đồn về chàng lan tới kinh đô khiến các hiệp sĩ mà chàng rời bỏ tức giận.

id: Bekas kaisar dari Kekaisaran Bariura yang hancur total, dia nantinya menjadi satu dari Enam Pahlawan.  Dia adalah yang terkuat di Bariura, tapi ketika dia menghilang, orang tuanya dibunuh. Marah, dia lalu membunuh ksatria yang dikiranya bertanggung jawab atas pembunuhan itu. Gambaran pertarungannya memberi semangat orang-orang dan menakutkan para ksatria.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60013_DESCRIPTION
desc: A former knight from the utterly devastated Bariura Empire, he later became one of the Six Heroes. He was the strongest in Bariura, but while he was gone, his parents were murdered. Enraged, he went on to mercilessly kill the knights he thought to be responsible. The image of him fighting encouraged the people and frightened the knights.

raw.es: Antiguo caballero del imperio de Bariula, que se convirtió en uno de los Seis Héroes. Durante su ausencia, sus padres fueron asesinados. Nada más enterarse, decidió volver a la capital con sed de venganza. Verlo luchar animó a muchos a rebelarse contra el ejército.

Enfurecido, ele matou impiedosamente os cavaleiros que considerou responsáveis. A imagem dele lutando encorajou o povo e aterrorizou os cavaleiros.
raw.th: อดีตอัศวินจากจักรวรรดิบาริอุละที่ถูกทำลายอย่างสิ้นเชิง ภายหลังเขาได้เป็นหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษ เขาแข็งแกร่งที่สุดในบาริอุละ แต่ขณะที่เขาไม่อยู่พ่อกับแม่ของเขาถูกสังหาร ด้วยความโกระเขาไปสังหารอัศวินที่เจาคิดว่ามีส่วนเกี่ยวข้องอย่างไร้ความปรานี ภาพการต่อสู้ของเขาเป็นแรงจูงใจให้กับประชาชนและทำให้เหล่าอัศวินหลาดกลัว
raw.vi: Một người trước đây từng là hiệp sĩ tới từ Đế quốc Bariura bị tàn phá nặng nề, sau này trở thành một trong sáu vị anh hùng. Chàng là người mạnh nhất trong Bariura, nhưng khi chàng vắng nhà, cha mẹ chàng bị sát hại. Quá tức giận, chàng không thương tiếc giết các hiệp sĩ chàng cho là phải chịu trách nhiệm về cái chết của cha mẹ. Hình ảnh chàng chiến đấu cổ vũ người dân và khiến các hiệp sĩ sợ hãi.

id: Bekas kaisar dari Kekaisaran Bariura yang hancur total, dia menggunakan tombak raksasa sebagai satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Dia menuju ibu kota setelah tahu yang membunuh orang tuanya takut akan kekuatannya. Tapi, perang melawan para dewa mulai tidak lama kemudian. Dia membunuh banyak dewa dalam perjalanannya untuk bertemu kaisar, membuatnya dipuji lebih lagi. Tapi, tidak diketahui apakah dia berhasil membalaskan dendamnya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60014_DESCRIPTION
desc: A former knight from the utterly devastated Bariura Empire, he wielded a giant lance as one of the Six Heroes. He headed to the capital once he found out who had killed his parents in fear of his power. However, the war with the gods soon began. He killed countless gods on his way to face the emperor, earning him even more praise. It is, however, yet unknown as to whether or not he got his revenge.

raw.pt: Um ex-cavaleiro do Império devastado de Bariura, ele empunhava uma lança gigante como um dos Seis Heróis. Ele foi à capital assim que descobriu quem havia matado seus pais temendo seu poder. Logo, a guerra com os deuses começou. Ele matou incontáveis deuses em seu caminho para enfrentar o Imperador, rendendo ainda mais louvor a ele. Mas não se sabe se ele conseguiu ou não sua vingança.
raw.th: อดีตอัศวินจากจักรวรรดิบาริอุละที่ถูกทำลายอย่างสิ้นเชิง เขากวัดแกว่งหลาวยักษ์ในฐานะหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษ เขามุ่งหน้าไปที่เมืองหลวงหลังจากรู้ตัวการที่สังหารพ่อกับแม่ของเขาเพราะหวาดกลัวพลังที่เขามี อย่างไรก็ดี ไม่นานสงครามกับเหล่าเทพเจ้าก็เกิดขึ้น เขาฆ่าเทพเจ้ามากมายระหว่างทางที่จะบุกไปหาจักรพรรดิ กลับยิ่งทำให้เขาได้รับการสรรเสริญ แต่กระนั้นก็ไม่มีใครรู้ว่าเขาได้ทำการล้างแค้นรึเปล่า
raw.vi: MMột người trước đây từng là hiệp sĩ tới từ Đế quốc Bariura bị tàn phá nặng nề, chàng nắm giữ một cây thương khổng lồ và là một trong sáu vị anh hùng. Một lần chàng kiên quyết tới thủ đô để tìm ra người giết hại cha mẹ mình vì hắn lo sợ bị mất đi quyền lực. Tuy nhiên, cuộc chiến với các vị thần sớm bắt đầu. Chàng giết vô số vị thần trên đường để đối mặt với hoàng đế, thành tựu chàng đạt được ngày càng nhiều hơn. Tuy nhiên, không ai biết chàng đã trả thù được hay chưa.

id: Mantan ksatria dari Kekaisaran Bariura yang sangat hancur, ia membawa tombak raksasa sebagai salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Membalas dendam melawan kaisar yang membunuh kedua orang tuanya, ia membabat banyak dewa dan akhirnya langsung ditarget oleh pemimpin dewa. Saat perang mulai, Magress bertahan hidup dengan menyerap kekuatan para dewa. Mengambil keterampilan mereka dan juta perlengkapannya, katanya ia berbentuk yang tidak dikenali kalau itu manusia.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60015_DESCRIPTION
desc: A former knight from the utterly devastated Bariura Empire, he wielded a giant lance as one of the Six Heroes. While seeking revenge against the emperor who murdered his parents, he cut down countless gods and was eventually targeted directly by their leader. As the war waged on, Magress survived by absorbing the power of the gods. Taking on their skills as well as their equipment, it was said he took on a form that made him unrecognizable as a human.

raw.en: A former knight from the utterly devastated Bariura Empire, he wielded a giant lance as one of the Six Heroes. While seeking revenge against the emperor who murdered his parents, he cut down countless gods and was eventually targeted directly by their leader. As the war waged on, Magress survived by absorbing the power of the gods. Taking on their skills as well as their equipment, it was said he took on a form that made him unrecognizable as a human.
raw.es: Antiguo caballero del devastado imperio Bariura que blandía una lanza gigante y fue uno de los Seis héroes. Durante su búsqueda de venganza contra el emperador que había matado a sus padres, Magress derrotó a una cantidad innumerables de dioses, lo que hizo que el líder de la orden lo eligiera como blanco personal. A medida que la guerra continuaba su curso, Magress sobrevivió absorbiendo el poder de los dioses. Tras apoderarse de sus habilidades y equipamiento, se dice que tomó una forma que hacía imposible reconocerlo como humano.
raw.id: Mantan ksatria dari Kekaisaran Bariura yang sangat hancur, ia membawa tombak raksasa sebagai salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Membalas dendam melawan kaisar yang membunuh kedua orang tuanya, ia membabat banyak dewa dan akhirnya langsung ditarget oleh pemimpin dewa. Saat perang mulai, Magress bertahan hidup dengan menyerap kekuatan para dewa. Mengambil keterampilan mereka dan juta perlengkapannya, katanya ia berbentuk yang tidak dikenali kalau itu manusia.
raw.pt: Um ex-cavaleiro do Império devastado de Bariura, ele empunhava uma lança gigante como um dos Seis Heróis. Enquanto buscava vingança contra o imperador que matou seus pais, ele abateu incontáveis deuses e eventualmente se tornou alvo do líder. Conforme a guerra avançou, Magress sobreviveu absorvendo o poder dos deuses. Tomando suas habilidades assim como seu equipamento, dizem que ele tomou uma forma que o tornou irreconhecível como humano.
raw.th: อดีตอัศวินจากจักรวรรดิบาริอุละที่ถูกทำลายอย่างสิ้นเชิง เขากวัดแกว่งหลาวยักษ์ในฐานะหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษ ขณะที่ตามล่าจักรพรรดิเพื่อล้างแค้นที่สังหารพ่อแม่ของเขา เขาสังหารเทพเจ้าไปมากมายและในที่สุดก็ตกเป็นเป้าหมายจากหัวหน้าของพวกนั้น ในขณะที่สงครามยืดเยื้อต่อไป มาเกรสรอดชีวิตด้วยการดูดซับพลังของเทพเจ้า ยึดความสามารถรวมถึงอุปกรณ์ของพวกนั้นมาด้วย ว่ากันว่าเขายึดเอาร่างกายที่ทำให้ดูไม่ออกว่าเขาเป็นมนุษย์อีกต่อไป
raw.vi: Một cựu hiệp sĩ đến từ đế chế Bauriua đã bị tàn phá hoàn toàn, anh sử dụng một cây thương khổng lồ với tư cách là một trong Sáu vị anh hùng. Mặc dù tìm cách trả thù lại hoàng đế đã giết hại bố mẹ mình, anh đã hạ vô số các vị thần và cuối cùng trở thành mục tiêu nhắm tới của lãnh đạo của họ. Khi chiến tranh bắt đầu, Magress sống sót bằng cách hấp thụ sức mạnh của các vị thần. Tiếp thu các kỹ năng cũng như trang bị thiết bị của họ, người ta nói rằng anh đã tiếp nhận một hình dáng khiến mọi người không thể nhận ra anh là một con người nữa.

id: Ketika kameradnya kalah di tangan Narza, Magress juga mengalami kesulitan. Di antara teman-temannya ada satu yang meskipun pernah mengeklaim benci pada pengkhianat, mengorbankan dirinya untuk menyelamatkan Magress. Termakan oleh amarah balas dendam, Magress membunuh Narza meskipun dia terluka di sekujur tubuhnya. Seorang ksatria muncul di depannya untuk memberinya sebuah pesan. Magress melepaskan setiap bagian dari zirahnya yang berat kecuali tombak kesayangannya, dan meskipun tidak bisa bergerak, menantang ksatria misterius itu untuk duel yang tak bisa dimenangkannya. Selagi menghadapi kematian, Magress mengucapkan kata-kata terima kasih karena bisa mati sebagai ksatria.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60016_DESCRIPTION
desc: As his comrades fell at the hands of Narza, Magress fell into quite the predicament himself. Amongst his friends was one who although having previously claimed to hate traitors, sacrificed himself in order to save Magress. Consumed by the rage of vengeance, Magress slaughtered Narza while completely covered in wounds. A lone knight appeared shortly after to relay a message to him. Magress discarded every piece of his heavy armor except for his beloved lance, and though unable to move, challenged the mysterious knight to a duel he couldn't win. As he perished, Magress uttered words of gratitude for being able to die as a knight.

raw.en: As his comrades fell at the hands of Narza, Magress fell into quite the predicament himself. Amongst his friends was one who although having previously claimed to hate traitors, sacrificed himself in order to save Magress. Consumed by the rage of vengeance, Magress slaughtered Narza while completely covered in wounds. A lone knight appeared shortly after to relay a message to him. Magress discarded every piece of his heavy armor except for his beloved lance, and though unable to move, challenged the mysterious knight to a duel he couldn't win. As he perished, Magress uttered words of gratitude for being able to die as a knight.
raw.es: Mientras sus camaradas caían en las manos de Narza, Magress se vio envuelto en un dilema. Entre sus amigos había uno que, si bien había asegurado odiar a los traidores, se sacrificó para salvar a Magress. Consumido por la ira y la venganza, Magress, completamente cubierto de heridas, asesinó a Narza. Al poco tiempo, un caballero solitario apareció frente a él para darle un mensaje. Magress se quitó toda su armadura, excepto por su preciosa lanza, y si bien no podía moverse, desafío al misterioso caballero a un duelo que no podía ganar. Mientras desaparecía de este mundo, Magress agradeció que lo dejaran morir como caballero.

raw.pt: Enquanto seus camaradas morriam nas mãos de Narza, Magress caiu na mesma situação. Entre seus amigos havia um que, mesmo dizendo odiar traidores, sacrificou-se para salvar Magress. Consumido por raiva e vingança, Magress acabou com Narza mesmo completamente ferido. Um cavaleiro apareceu para ele com uma mensagem. Magress tirou toda sua armadura, exceto sua lança, e mesmo sem poder se mover, desafio o cavaleiro para uma batalha que não poderia vencer. Enquanto perecia, Magress agradecia por morrer como um cavaleiro.
raw.th: เพราะเพื่อนของมาร์เกรสตกอยู่ในเงื้อมมือของนาร์ซ่า ทำให้เขากลืนไม่เข้าคายไม่ออก ยิ่งเพื่อนของเขากล่าวไว้ว่ารังเกียจพวกคนทรยศ และยอมสละชีวิตตัวเองเพื่อช่วยมาร์เกรสด้วยแล้ว ทำให้แรงแค้นครอบงำ มาร์เกรสจึงสังหารนาร์ซ่าขณะกำลังฟื้นฟูบาดแผล ทันใดนั้น อัศวินผู้หนึ่งได้ปรากฎตัวขึ้นและบอกสารกับมาร์เกรส ทำให้เขาถอดเกราะทุกชิ้นออกเพื่อรับคมหอกของตน ทำให้ขยับไม่ได้ และยังท้ารบกับอัศวินซึ่งเขาไม่มีทางชนะแน่ๆ และก่อนตาย มาร์เกรสได้ลั่นวาจาขอบคุณที่ทำเขาตายเยี่ยงอัศวิน
raw.vi: Khi các đồng đội của anh rơi vào tay Narza, bản thân Magress cũng rơi vào tình thế khá khó khăn. Trong số bạn anh có một người mặc dù từng tuyên bố là ghét những kẻ phản bội, nhưng đã hy sinh bản thân để cứu Magress. Bị thiêu đốt bởi cơn thịnh nộ muốn trả thù, Magress đã giết Narza mặc dù khắp người toàn vết thương. Ngay sau đó, một hiệp sĩ đơn độc đã xuất hiện để truyền một thông điệp tới anh. Magress đã cởi bỏ hết bộ áo giáp nặng nề của mình ngoại trừ cây thương anh yêu quý và mặc dù không thể di chuyển, anh đã thách thức hiệp sĩ bí ẩn bằng một trận đấu mà anh đã không thể thắng. Khi anh chết, Magress đã nói những lời cảm ơn vì có để được chết như một hiệp sĩ.

id: Samurai dari dunia lain yang muncul di Kekaisaran Bariura yang hancur. Katana Mifune berbeda dengan pedang lain yang ada di Gaia Besar karena sabetannya yang ampuh. Bisa memotong dengan sangat baik dan katanya yang dipotong oleh pedang ini tidak merasakan sakit. Cerita terkenal ini tentang dia menolak undangan kaisar dengan berkata, "Seorang yang bodoh tidak akan menjadi tuanku."
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60021_DESCRIPTION
desc: An other-worldly samurai that appeared in the ruined Bariura Empire. Mifune's katana is different from other swords in Grand Gaia thanks to its superior slashing ability. It cuts amazingly well, and it's said that those cut by it die without feeling pain. There's a famous tale of him refusing an invitation from the emperor by saying, "A fool will never be my master."

raw.en: An other-worldly samurai that appeared in the ruined Bariura Empire. Mifune's katana is different from other swords in Grand Gaia thanks to its superior slashing ability. It cuts amazingly well, and it's said that those cut by it die without feeling pain. There's a famous tale of him refusing an invitation from the emperor by saying, "A fool will never be my master."
raw.es: Samurái de otro mundo, que apareció en el antiguo imperio de Bariula. Su katana es distinta a cualquier otra espada de Gran Gaia y mucho más afilada. No solo puede atravesar a cualquier monstruo, sino que además lo mata sin que sienta dolor. Cuentan que el emperador quiso invitarlo una vez a palacio y su respuesta fue: "No pienso servir a un idiota".

raw.pt: Um samurai de outro mundo que apareceu no Império arruinado de Bariura. A katana de Mifune é diferente de outras espadas em Grand Gaia graças a seu potencial superior de corte. Ela corta extremamente bem, e dizem que aqueles abatidos por ela morrem sem sentir dor. Existe um famoso conto onde ele recusa um convite de um imperador dizendo que “Um tolo nunca será meu mestre”.
raw.th: ซามูไรจากโลกอื่นที่ปรากฏตัวในจักรวรรดิบาริอุละที่ล่มสลาย ดาบคาตาน่าของมิฟูเนะแตกต่างจากดาบอื่นๆในแกรนด์ไกอาและด้วยความสามารถในการฟันที่เหนือกว่า มันจึงตัดได้อย่างยอดเยี่ยม และว่ากันว่าผู้ที่ถูกมันฟันจะตายโดยไม่รู้สึกเจ็บปวด มีเรื่องเล่าโด่งดังของเขาที่ปฏเสธคำชักชวนขององค์จักรพรรดิด้วยการบอกว่า "คนโง่ย่อมไม่มีวันได้เป็นนายของข้า"
raw.vi: Một võ sĩ đạo thế giới khác xuất hiện trong Đế quốc Bariura đổ nát. Katana của Mifune khác nhau với các thanh kiếm khác tại Grand Gaia nhờ khả năng chém vượt trội. Nó sắc bén một cách đáng ngạc nhiên, người ta nói những người bị thanh kiếm này chém chết mà không có cảm giác đau. Có một câu chuyện nổi tiếng kể rằng chàng từ chối lời mời từ các hoàng đế bằng cách nói, "Một kẻ ngốc sẽ không bao giờ là chủ của tôi của tôi."

id: Samurai dari dunia lain yang muncul di Kekaisaran Bariura yang hancur. Dia bertarung di berbagai duel terkenal dengan katananya yang spesial. Gosipnya tersebar di Gaia Besar dan banyak jago pedang yang menantangnya. Kekuatan sesungguhnya dari katana yang dicintainya bangkit dalam pertarungan itu. Itu adalah pedang setan yang haus akan darah manusia. Tidak bisa menahan diri, dia termakan oleh kekuatannya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60022_DESCRIPTION
desc:
An other-worldly samurai that appeared in the ruined Bariura Empire. He fought in many famous duels with his special katana.
Rumors spread around Grand Gaia and many swordsmen challenged him. His beloved katana awakened its true power during those fights. It was a demonic blade that lusted for human blood. Unable to restrain himself, he gave in to its power.

raw.pt:
Um samurai de outro mundo que apareceu no Império arruinado de Bariura. Ele lutou em muitos duelos famosos com sua katana especial.
Boatos se espalharam por Grand Gaia e muitos espadachins o desafiaram. Sua amada katana despertou seu poder verdadeiro durante essas lutas. Era uma lâmina demoníaca com sede de sangue humano. Incapaz dxe se conter, ele cedeu ao poder.
raw.th: ซามูไรจากโลกอื่นที่ปรากฏตัวในจักรวรรดิบาริอุละที่ล่มสลาย เขาผ่านการดวลที่โด่งดังมามากมายพร้อมกับดาบคาตาน่าพิเศษของเขา คำร่ำลือแผ่ไปทั่วแกรนด์ไกอาและนักดาบมากมาก็มาท้าประลองกับเขา ดาบคาตาน่าสุดรักของเขาได้สำแดงพลังที่แท้จริงออกมาระหว่างการต่อสู้เหล่านั้น มันเป็นดาบมารที่กระหายเลือดของมนุษย์ เขาไม่สามารถยับยั้งตัวเองและตกอยู่ใต้อำนาจของมัน
raw.vi:
Một võ sĩ đạo thế giới khác xuất hiện trong Đế quốc Bariura đổ nát. Chàng cùng thanh kiếm Katana đặc biệt chiến đấu trong nhiều trận đấu tay đôi nổi tiếng.
Tin đồn lan truyền khắp Grand Gaia và nhiều kiếm sĩ tìm tới thách thức chàng. Katana yêu quý đánh thức sức mạnh thực sự của chàng trong những trận đấu. Đó là một Lưỡi dao ma quỷ thèm khát máu của con người. Không thể kiềm chế bản thân, chàng hòa vào sức mạnh của nó.

id: Samurai yang muncul di Kekaisaran Bariura yang hancur. Keahliannya terasah dengan setiap perang melawan para dewa, dan bahkan pada saat hampir mati katanya dia membunuh seekor naga besar dalam satu serangan. Meskipun dia sekarat tanpa kembali ke dunianya, dia menghadapi kematian dengan tenang. Vargas, yang pernah bertarung melawannya, berkata, "Dia mendapatkan kematian yang diinginkannya."
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60023_DESCRIPTION
desc: An other-worldly samurai that appeared in the ruined Bariura Empire. His skill sharpened with each battle against the gods, and even whilst on the brink of death it's said he slew a giant dragon in one blow. Despite Mifune dying without returning to his world, he calmly faced death. Vargas, who had crossed blades with him before, said, "He found the death he desired."

Người ta kể rằng chàng chỉ ra một đòn đã giết chết một con rồng khổng lồ. Mặc dù Mifune chết mà không thể trở về thế giới của mình, chàng bình tĩnh đối mặt với cái chết. Vargas, người thắng chàng trước kia nói: "Anh thấy cái chết anh mong muốn."

id: Samurai dunia lain yang muncul di reruntuhan Kekaisaran Bariura. Pedang setan di tangan, Mifune menemukan maut yang dia dambakan selagi bertarung agresif melawan para dewa. Namun pedang setan yang dibawanya tidak mengizinkan ia mati dengan mudah. Bersama si pedang yang sudah membunuh banyak orang, setelah mati, keterampilan Mifune semakin terasah, dan ia sanggup memenggal para dewa dengan sekali serang.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60024_DESCRIPTION
desc: An other-worldly samurai that appeared in the ruined Bariura Empire. Demonic blade in hand, Mifune found the death he so desired as he fought aggressively against the gods. However, the demonic blade he carried wouldn't allow him to pass on so easily. Together with his demonic blade that had already claimed so many lives, upon death Mifune's skills sharpened even further, and it's said he was then able to chop down gods in a single blow.

raw.en: An other-worldly samurai that appeared in the ruined Bariura Empire. Demonic blade in hand, Mifune found the death he so desired as he fought aggressively against the gods. However, the demonic blade he carried wouldn't allow him to pass on so easily. Together with his demonic blade that had already claimed so many lives, upon death Mifune's skills sharpened even further, and it's said he was then able to chop down gods in a single blow.
raw.es: Samurái de otro mundo que apreció en el devastado imperio Bariura. Armado con una espada demoníaca, Mifune encontró la muerte que tanto deseaba mientras luchaba ferozmente contra los dioses. Sin embargo, su espada demoníaca no lo dejó viajar al más allá tan fácilmente. Al borde de la muerte y junto con su espada demoníaca, que ya había tomado tantas vidas, las habilidades de Mifune aumentaron más aún, y se dice que entonces pudo rebanar dioses con un solo movimiento de su espada.
raw.id: Samurai dunia lain yang muncul di reruntuhan Kekaisaran Bariura. Pedang setan di tangan, Mifune menemukan maut yang dia dambakan selagi bertarung agresif melawan para dewa. Namun pedang setan yang dibawanya tidak mengizinkan ia mati dengan mudah. Bersama si pedang yang sudah membunuh banyak orang, setelah mati, keterampilan Mifune semakin terasah, dan ia sanggup memenggal para dewa dengan sekali serang.
raw.pt: Um samurai de outro mundo que apareceu no Reino arruinado de Bariura. De lâmina demoníaca em punho, Mifune encontrou a morte que tanto buscava na luta violenta contra os deuses. Porém a lâmina-demônio que empunhava não o deixaria descansar tão facilmente. Junto da espada demoníaca que já havia tomado tantas vidas, na morte as habilidades de Mifune se afiaram ainda mais, e dizem que ele conseguia ceifar deuses em um único golpe.
raw.th: อดีตอัศวินจากจักรวรรดิบาริอุละที่ถูกทำลายอย่างสิ้นเชิง เขากวัดแกว่งหลาวยักษ์ในฐานะหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษ ขณะที่ตามล่าจักรพรรดิเพื่อล้างแค้นที่สังหารพ่อแม่ของเขา เขาสังหารเทพเจ้าไปมากมายและในที่สุดก็ตกเป็นเป้าหมายจากหัวหน้าของพวกนั้น ในขณะที่สงครามยืดเยื้อต่อไป มาเกรสรอดชีวิตด้วยการดูดซับพลังของเทพเจ้า ยึดความสามารถรวมถึงอุปกรณ์ของพวกนั้นมาด้วย ว่ากันว่าเขายึดเอาร่างกายที่ทำให้ดูไม่ออกว่าเขาเป็นมนุษย์อีกต่อไป
raw.vi: Một samurai của thế giới khác xuất hiện tại Đế chế Bariura đổ nát. Với lưỡi kiếm ma quỷ trong tay, Mifune tìm đến cái chết mà anh mong muốn khi anh đã chiến đấu quyết liệt chống lại các vị thần. Tuy nhiên, lưỡi kiếm ma quỷ anh mang sẽ không cho phép anh bỏ qua quá dễ dàng. Cùng với lưỡi kiếm ma quỷ của mình đã tước đi rất nhiều mạng sống, thì các kỹ năng chết chóc của Mifune trở nên nhạy bén hơn nữa và người ta nói rằng sau đó anh đã có thể đốn hạ các vị thần chỉ bằng một nhát kiếm.

id: Samurai dari negara lain yang memainkan peranan aktif selama perang besar dengan para dewa. Pernah mengunjungi dunia bawa sekali, ia dihidupkan kembali oleh pedang setannya, namun perlahan kembali manusiawi karena ia mengikuti semangat bertarungnya. Saat menyatu dengan pedang setannya, harga diri Mifune yang baru sebagai samurai mengisi dirinya dengan kekuatan melampaui manusia biasa dengan kemampuannya. Bahkan di garis depan Bariura yang terus-menerus kalah, di sekeliling Mifune terciprati merahnya darah para dewa.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60025_DESCRIPTION
desc: An otherworldly samurai who played an active role during the great war with the gods. Having already visited the underworld once, he was brought back to life by his demonic blade, gradually recovering his humanity as he clung to his fighting spirit. As he became one with his demonic blade, Mifune's renewed pride as a samurai filled him with power, surpassing ordinary humans with his abilities. It is said that even at the frontlines of the continuously losing Bariura, Mifune's surroundings had been stained red with the gods' blood.

raw.en: An otherworldly samurai who played an active role during the great war with the gods. Having already visited the underworld once, he was brought back to life by his demonic blade, gradually recovering his humanity as he clung to his fighting spirit. As he became one with his demonic blade, Mifune's renewed pride as a samurai filled him with power, surpassing ordinary humans with his abilities. It is said that even at the frontlines of the continuously losing Bariura, Mifune's surroundings had been stained red with the gods' blood.
raw.es: Un samurái de otro mundo que jugó un rol importantísimo durante la guerra contra los dioses. La espada demoníaca de Mifune lo había sacado del inframundo la única vez que había estado allí, y él se aferró a su espíritu de lucha y comenzó a recuperar su humanidad lentamente. Mifune se convirtió en uno con su espada, y su renovado orgullo como samurái lo llenó de poder y le otorgó habilidades más potentes que las de todos los mortales. Se dice que incluso en la línea de batalla del mancillado y golpeado imperio de Bariura, la tierra que rodeaba a Mifune siempre estaba teñida con la sangre de los dioses.
raw.id: Samurai dari negara lain yang memainkan peranan aktif selama perang besar dengan para dewa. Pernah mengunjungi dunia bawa sekali, ia dihidupkan kembali oleh pedang setannya, namun perlahan kembali manusiawi karena ia mengikuti semangat bertarungnya. Saat menyatu dengan pedang setannya, harga diri Mifune yang baru sebagai samurai mengisi dirinya dengan kekuatan melampaui manusia biasa dengan kemampuannya. Bahkan di garis depan Bariura yang terus-menerus kalah, di sekeliling Mifune terciprati merahnya darah para dewa.
raw.pt: Um samurai de outro mundo que exerceu um papel ativo durante a grande guerra contra os deuses. Ele já visitou o submundo uma vez e foi trazido de volta por sua espada diabólica. Aos poucos recupera sua humanidade enquanto se prende ao seu espírito guerreiro. Conforme ele se tornou um com sua espada diabólica, com o orgulho renovado e dotado do poder de samurai, Mifune foi ficando mais forte que os humanos em suas habilidades. Diziam que até mesmo nas linhas de frente das derrotas de Bariura Mifune estava coberto pelo sangue dos deuses.
raw.th: ซามูไรจากโลกอื่นผู้มีบทบาทสำคัญระหว่างสงครามครั้งใหญ่กับเทพเจ้า เมื่อได้ผ่านความตายมาหนึ่งครั้ง เขาถูกชุบชีวิตขึ้นมาด้วยดาบมารของเขา , ค่อยๆ ฟื้นความเป็นมนุษย์ของเขาในขณะที่เขายังยึดติดกับจิตวิญญาณการต่อสู้ของเขา ขณะที่เขาเป็นหนึ่งเดียวกับดาบมารของเขา ศักดิ์ศรีของซามูไรที่ฟื้นขึ้นมาของมิฟูเนะได้เติมพลังให้กับเขา จนข้ามผ่านระดับมนุษย์ธรรมดาด้วยความสามารถของเขา ว่ากันว่าแม้ว่าแนวหน้าที่กำลังพ่ายแพ้ไปเรื่อยๆ ของบาริอุระ รอบตัวของมิฟูเนะก็ถูกอาบไปด้วยสีแดงจากเลือดของเทพเจ้า
raw.vi: Một samurai của thế giới khác đã đóng vai trò tích cực trong cuộc đại chiến với các vị thần. Đã từng một lần sống đi chết lại, anh được hồi sinh nhờ lưỡi kiếm yêu ma của mình, từ từ khôi phục nhân tính khi anh giữ tinh thần chiến đấu của mình. Khi anh hợp nhất thành một với lưỡi kiếm yêu ma của mình, niềm kiêu hãnh trở lại của Mifune như một samurai làm anh tràn đầy sức mạnh, vượt qua những người bình thường với khả năng của anh. Tương truyền rằng ngay cả khi ở tiền tuyến của Bariura liên tục thua, những người xung quanh Mifune đã nhuộm đỏ máu của các vị thần.

id: Jelly Berkilau yang bermutasi setelah dihujani oleh sihir. Sangat brutal dan menyerang manusia yang dijumpainya, sembari mengumpat. Tapi, karena dia sangat lemah seperti jelly lainnya, masih merupakan lawan yang baik untuk Pemanggil yang baru. Katanya mereka juga kadang-kadang menunjukkan kebaikan. Beberapa berpikir mungkin dia seperti Jelly Berkilau dan mungkin dia hanya kesepian.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60030_DESCRIPTION
desc: Glowy's mutated form after being showered with magic. It has an extremely brutal nature and attacks any humans it finds, all whilst constantly spitting out obscenities. However, since it is very weak like other liquid-type monsters, it is still a good sparring partner for new Summoners. They've also been said to show kindness at times. Some think that it's actually just like a Glowy, except that it acts up because it feels lonely.

raw.en: Glowy's mutated form after being showered with magic. It has an extremely brutal nature and attacks any humans it finds, all whilst constantly spitting out obscenities. However, since it is very weak like other liquid-type monsters, it is still a good sparring partner for new Summoners. They've also been said to show kindness at times. Some think that it's actually just like a Glowy, except that it acts up because it feels lonely.
raw.es: Forma mutada de Brillito tras imbuirse de magia maligna. Posee un carácter de lo más violento y ataca a cualquiera que se encuentre, eso mientras no para de soltar insultos. Es no obstante es un monstruo débil y un compañero óptimo para todo invocador novato. Dicen que algunos pueden ser buenos si se lo proponen, otros piensan que simplemente es que les gusta llamar la atención.
raw.id: Jelly Berkilau yang bermutasi setelah dihujani oleh sihir. Sangat brutal dan menyerang manusia yang dijumpainya, sembari mengumpat. Tapi, karena dia sangat lemah seperti jelly lainnya, masih merupakan lawan yang baik untuk Pemanggil yang baru. Katanya mereka juga kadang-kadang menunjukkan kebaikan. Beberapa berpikir mungkin dia seperti Jelly Berkilau dan mungkin dia hanya kesepian.
raw.pt: A forma mutante de um visco Glowy depois de ser banhado por magia. Tem uma natureza extremamente brutal e ataca todos os humanos que encontra, enquanto vocifera obscenidades. Apesar disso ele é tão fraco quanto outros viscos, sendo ainda um bom parceiro de treino para novos Invocadores. Também dizem que às vezes eles demonstram gentileza. Alguns dizem que ele é apenas como o visco Glowy mas que talvez esteja solitário.
raw.th: สไลม์เรืองแสงกลายพันธุ์หลังจากได้อาบเวทมนตร์ มันมีนิสัยตามธรรมชาติที่ดุร้ายมากและจะโจมตีคนที่มันพบ ขณะพูดจาหยาบคายอย่างต่อเนื่อง อย่างไรก็ตามด้วยความที่มันอ่อนแอเหมือนสไลม์อื่นๆ มันก็เป็นคู่หูฝึกซ้อมชั้ดีของซัมมอนเนอร์มือใหม่ กล่าวกันว่าบางครั้งพวกมันก็ใจดี บางคนคิดว่ามันก็แค่เหมือนกับสไลม์เรืองแสงและบางทีมันอาจจะแค่เหงา
raw.vi: Glowy Slime có hình dạng đột biến sau khi được tắm rửa bằng ma thuật. Bản chất nó vô cùng tàn bạo. Nó tấn công người nó tìm thấy, trong khi liên tục phun ra những lời tục tĩu. Tuy nhiên, vì nó là rất yếu như slimes khác, nó vẫn là đối tác tốt cho của người triệu hồi mới. Cũng có nhiều lần chúng thể hiện lòng tốt. Một số người nghĩ rằng nó thực sự giống như Glowy Slime và rằng có thể chỉ là nó cô đơn.

id: Seperti Jelly Berkilau, kalau beberapa Jelly Kegelapan bergabung, mereka menjadi Raja Jelly Kegelapan. Meskipun lebih brutal dan kasar dari Jelly Kegelapan, kadang juga masih tercampur kata-kata baik. Meskipun demikian, serangannya yang merusak dari tubuhnya yang besar juga lebih kuat, dan jelas lebih berbahaya. Dia juga punya sayap, tapi sama sekali tidak bisa terbang.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60031_DESCRIPTION
desc: Just like a Glowy, when multiple Gloomies come together, they transform into King Gloomy. Even though it's more brutal and obscene than a regular Gloomy, it still occasionally mixes in some kind words. Nonetheless, the destructive attacks it unleashes from its giant body are much stronger, and it is certainly more dangerous. It also has wings, but it has absolutely no ability to fly.

raw.en: Just like a Glowy, when multiple Gloomies come together, they transform into King Gloomy. Even though it's more brutal and obscene than a regular Gloomy, it still occasionally mixes in some kind words. Nonetheless, the destructive attacks it unleashes from its giant body are much stronger, and it is certainly more dangerous. It also has wings, but it has absolutely no ability to fly.
raw.es: Igual que con el rey Brillito, cuando varios de ellos se unen, acaban transformados en un rey Umbrío. Aunque es mucho más violento y mal hablado que su homónimo, de vez en cuando suelta alguna palabra amable. Sus ataques son sin duda alguna más poderosos y letales. Tiene alas, pero no puede volar.
raw.id: Seperti Jelly Berkilau, kalau beberapa Jelly Kegelapan bergabung, mereka menjadi Raja Jelly Kegelapan. Meskipun lebih brutal dan kasar dari Jelly Kegelapan, kadang juga masih tercampur kata-kata baik. Meskipun demikian, serangannya yang merusak dari tubuhnya yang besar juga lebih kuat, dan jelas lebih berbahaya. Dia juga punya sayap, tapi sama sekali tidak bisa terbang.
raw.pt: Exatamente com o visco Glowy, quando vários viscos sombrios se unem, eles se transformam no visco Gloomy Rei. Mesmo sendo mais brutal e obsceno que o visco Gloomy, às vezes ele ainda mistura algumas palavras gentis. Ainda assim, os ataques destrutivos que ele solta com seu corpo gigante são muito mais fortes, e ele é certamente mais perigoso. Ele também tem asas, mas não consegue voar.
raw.th: เหมือนกับสไลม์เรืองแสง เมื่อสไลม์มืดมารวมตัวกันเยอะๆ พวกมันจะรวมร่างเป็น ราชันย์สไลม์มืด แม้ว่าพวกมันจะดุร้ายและปากเสียยิ่งกว่าสไลม์มืด บางครั้งพวกมันก็พูดจาดีๆ ออกมาเหมือนกัน อย่างไรก็ดี พลังโจมตีที่ปล่อยออกมาจากร่างใหญ่ตของมันก็รุนแรงกว่ามากและอันตรายยิ่งกว่าอย่างแน่นอน พวกมันมีปีกด้วยแต่ไม่มีความสารถใดๆเลย ในด้านการบิน
raw.vi: Cũng giống như Glowy Slime, khi có nhiều Slimes bóng tối tập hợp lại, chúng biến thành vua Slime bóng tối. Mặc dù nó tàn bạo và tục tĩu hơn Slime bóng tối, nó vẫn thỉnh thoảng pha trộn một số từ loại. Tuy nhiên, các cuộc tấn công phá hủy đã giải phóng cơ thể khổng lồ của nó làm nó mạnh mẽ hơn, và chắc chắn là nguy hiểm hơn. Nó cũng có cánh, nhưng nó hoàn toàn không có khả năng bay.

id: Penyihir dari Kekaisaran Bariura yang hancur. Sihirnya adalh satu dari banyak keahlian yang dipelajari di Bariura. Awalnya adalah seni untuk meramal menggunakan astronomi dan kalendar, tapi dia membedakan keahliannya dengan mengutamakan kemampuan sihirnya. Buku sejarah mengatakan dia bisa memikat kekuatan alami, memanipulasi mereka, dan menimbulkan berbagai fenomena.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60040_DESCRIPTION
desc: A sorceress from the ruined Bariura Empire. Her sorcery was one of the various skills studied in Bariura. It was originally an art used to read fortunes using astronomy and calendars, but she set her own skills apart by emphasizing her magical abilities. History books say she was able to charm the natural forces, manipulating them and cause all sorts of phenomena.

raw.en: A sorceress from the ruined Bariura Empire. Her sorcery was one of the various skills studied in Bariura. It was originally an art used to read fortunes using astronomy and calendars, but she set her own skills apart by emphasizing her magical abilities. History books say she was able to charm the natural forces, manipulating them and cause all sorts of phenomena.
raw.es: Hechicera del antiguo imperio de Bariula, versada en una de muchas ramas que se estudiaban. Su arte se usó antiguamente para adivinar el futuro mediante la astronomía, pero ella logró darles un nuevo uso con su talento mágico. Según dicen, era capaz de invocar fuerzas naturales y manipularlas para crear todo tipo de fenómenos.
raw.id: Penyihir dari Kekaisaran Bariura yang hancur. Sihirnya adalh satu dari banyak keahlian yang dipelajari di Bariura. Awalnya adalah seni untuk meramal menggunakan astronomi dan kalendar, tapi dia membedakan keahliannya dengan mengutamakan kemampuan sihirnya. Buku sejarah mengatakan dia bisa memikat kekuatan alami, memanipulasi mereka, dan menimbulkan berbagai fenomena.
raw.pt: Uma feiticeira do Império arruinado Bariura. Sua feitiçaria era uma de muitas habilidades estudadas em Bariura. Originalmente era uma arte usada para ler a sorte usando astronomia e calendários, mas ela decidiu destacar suas habilidades enfatizando o potencial mágico. Livros de história dizem que ela podia encantar as forças da natureza, manipulando-as e causando toda sorte de fenômenos.
raw.th: นักเวทหญิงจากจักรวรรดิบาริอุละที่ล่มสลาย พลังเวทของเธอเป็นหนึ่งในทักษะหลากหลายที่เรียนในบาริอุละ ดั้งเดิมเป็นศาสตร์สำหรับพยากรดวงชะตาโดยใช้หลักดาราศาสตร์และปฏิทิน แต่เธอแยกทักษะของเธอออกจากกันโดยการเน้นไปที่ความสามารถทางเวทของเธอ หนังสือประวัติศาสตร์กล่าวไว้ว่าเธอสามารถใช้พลังของธรรมชาติและบงการพวกมันให้เกิดปรากฏการณ์ต่างๆได้
raw.vi: Một phù thủy tới từ Đế quốc Bariura đổ nát. Phép thuật của cô là một trong nhiều kỹ năng được nghiên cứu tại Bariura. Ban đầu nó là một thuật dùng để phán đoán vận may sử dụng thiên văn học và lịch, nhưng cô thiết lập các kỹ năng khác bằng cách nhấn mạnh khả năng phép thuật của mình. Sách lịch sử ghi rằng cô có thể quyến rũ các lực lượng tự nhiên, thao tác chúng và gây ra tất cả các loại hiện tượng.

id: Penyihir dari Kekaisaran Bariura yang hancur. Sihirnya adalh satu dari banyak keahlian yang dipelajari di Bariura. Awalnya adalah seni untuk meramal menggunakan astronomi dan kalendar, tapi dia membedakan keahliannya dengan mengutamakan kemampuan sihirnya. Tekniknya dengan efektif menggabungkan kekuatan kosmik dengan sihir. Karena jalannya berbeda dengan mereka yang berniat menjadi penyihir, dia disebut sebagai Pesulap.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60041_DESCRIPTION
desc: A sorceress from the ruined Bariura Empire. Her sorcery was one of the various skills studied in Bariura. It was originally an art used to read fortunes using astronomy and calendars, but she set her own skills apart by emphasizing her magical abilities. Her technique effectively combined cosmic forces with magic. As her path differed from those who aiming to remain as sorcerers, she came to be called a Magician instead.

raw.en: A sorceress from the ruined Bariura Empire. Her sorcery was one of the various skills studied in Bariura. It was originally an art used to read fortunes using astronomy and calendars, but she set her own skills apart by emphasizing her magical abilities. Her technique effectively combined cosmic forces with magic. As her path differed from those who aiming to remain as sorcerers, she came to be called a Magician instead.
raw.es: Hechicera del antiguo imperio de Bariula, versada en una de muchas ramas que se estudiaban. Su arte se usó antiguamente para adivinar el futuro mediante la astronomía, pero ella logró darles un nuevo uso con su talento mágico. Así logró combinar las artes cósmicas con las mágicas. Dado que su senda comenzó a dividirse del resto de hechiceras, decidió que se haría llamar maga.
raw.id: Penyihir dari Kekaisaran Bariura yang hancur. Sihirnya adalh satu dari banyak keahlian yang dipelajari di Bariura. Awalnya adalah seni untuk meramal menggunakan astronomi dan kalendar, tapi dia membedakan keahliannya dengan mengutamakan kemampuan sihirnya. Tekniknya dengan efektif menggabungkan kekuatan kosmik dengan sihir. Karena jalannya berbeda dengan mereka yang berniat menjadi penyihir, dia disebut sebagai Pesulap.
raw.pt: Uma feiticeira do Império arruinado Bariura. Sua feitiçaria era uma de muitas habilidades estudadas em Bariura. Originalmente era uma arte usada para ler a sorte usando astronomia e calendários, mas ela decidiu destacar suas habilidades enfatizando o potencial mágico. Sua técnica combinava forças cósmicas com magia. Como seu caminho era diferente daqueles que preferiam se manter na feitiçaria, ela passou a ser chamada de Maga.
raw.th: นักเวทหญิงจากจักรวรรดิบาริอุละที่ล่มสลาย พลังเวทของเธอเป็นหนึ่งในทักษะหลากหลายที่เรียนในบาริอุละ ดั้งเดิมเป็นศาสตร์สำหรับพยากรดวงชะตาโดยใช้หลักดาราศาสตร์และปฏิทิน แต่เธอแยกทักษะของเธอออกจากกันโดยการเน้นไปที่ความสามารถทางเวทของเธอ เทคนิคของเธอผสมผสานพลังจักรวาลและเวทมนตร์อย่างได้ผลดี เนื่องจากเส้นทางเป้าหมายของเธอนั้นแตกต่างจากนักเวทอื่นๆ เธอจึงถูกเรียกในภายหลังว่าจอมเวทแทน
raw.vi: Một phù thủy từ Bariura Đế quốc đổ nát. Phép thuật của mình là một trong những kỹ năng khác nhau trong nghiên cứu Bariura. Ban đầu nó được một nghệ thuật sử dụng để đọc vận may sử dụng thiên văn học và lịch, nhưng cô thiết lập các kỹ năng của mình ngoài bằng cách nhấn mạnh khả năng phép thuật của mình. Kỹ thuật của cô kết hợp một cách hiệu quả các lực lượng vũ trụ với phép thuật. Vì con đường của cô khác với những người đặt  mục tiêu là phù thủy, cô được gọi là một nhà phép thuật thay thế.

id: Penyihir dari Kekaisaran Bariura yang hancur. Kekuatan sihirnya tumbuh kuat lebih dari penyihir atau pesulap lainnya. Tapi semakin dia bertambah kuat, semakin jauh orang-orang di sekitarnya, tapi dia terus berdedikasi pada risetnya. Kelakuannya semakin parah karena dia menukarkan hubungan demi kekuatan, dan bahkan dia dianggap sebagai orang luar di dalam kekaisaran sendiri.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60042_DESCRIPTION
desc: A sorceress from the ruined Bariura Empire. Her powers of sorcery were evolved far beyond any other sorcerer or magician. However, as her power increased, those around her moved farther and farther away, but without pause she continued to devote herself to her research. Her behavior deteriorated as she gave up relationships for power, and soon even within the empire she was seen as an outsider.

raw.en: A sorceress from the ruined Bariura Empire. Her powers of sorcery were evolved far beyond any other sorcerer or magician. However, as her power increased, those around her moved farther and farther away, but without pause she continued to devote herself to her research. Her behavior deteriorated as she gave up relationships for power, and soon even within the empire she was seen as an outsider.
raw.es: Hechicera del devastado imperio Bariura. Sus poderes de hechicería evolucionaron más allá que los de cualquier hechicero o mago. Sin embargo, mientras su poder aumentaba, las personas a su alrededor se alejaban cada vez más, pero Lily continuaba dedicándose a su investigación. Su comportamiento se deterioró cuando abandonó todas sus relaciones por el poder, y pronto comenzaron a verla como una extraña incluso dentro del imperio.
raw.id: Penyihir dari Kekaisaran Bariura yang hancur. Kekuatan sihirnya tumbuh kuat lebih dari penyihir atau pesulap lainnya. Tapi semakin dia bertambah kuat, semakin jauh orang-orang di sekitarnya, tapi dia terus berdedikasi pada risetnya. Kelakuannya semakin parah karena dia menukarkan hubungan demi kekuatan, dan bahkan dia dianggap sebagai orang luar di dalam kekaisaran sendiri.
raw.pt: Uma feiticeira do Império arruinado Bariura. Seus poderes de feitiçaria evoluíram muito além de qualquer feiticeiro ou mago. Porém, à medida que seu poder crescia, aqueles à sua volta se distanciavam ainda mais, mas sem titubear ela continuou a se dedicar à pesquisa. Seu comportamento deteriorou quando ela abandonou relacionamentos por poder, e logo até mesmo no império ela era vista como uma estranha.
raw.th: นักเวทหญิงจากจักรวรรดิบาริอุราที่ล่มสลาย พลังเวทของเธอนั้นพัฒนาล้ำเกินจอมเวทอื่นๆ อย่างไรก็ตาม ขณะที่พลังของเธอมากขึ้นนั้นผู้คนรอบข้างเธอก็ย้ายห่างและห่างออกไปเรื่อยๆ  แต่เธอก็ยังทุ่มเทให้กับการค้นคว้าต่อไปอย่างไม่หยุดยั้ง  พฤติกรรมของเธอแย่ลงขณะที่เธอละทิ้งความสัมพันธ์เพื่อพลัง และจากนั้นไม่นาน แม้จะอยู่ในอาณาจักร เธอก็ยังถูกมองว่าเป็นคนนอก
raw.vi: Một phù thủy đến từ Vương quốc Bariura bị tàn phá. Quyền hạn phép thuật của bà ta đã phát triển vượt xa bất kì phù thủy nào khác. Tuy nhiên, khi quyền lực của bà ta tăng lên, những người xung quan bà ta dần dần xa lánh bà mà không ngăn chặn bà ta thôi không nghiên cứu phép thuật nữa. Hành vi của bà ta dần trở nên xấu đi khi bà ta từ bỏ các mối quan hệ vì quyền lực và sau đó không lâu bà ta bị cả vương quốc xem là người ngoài cuộc.

id: Monster mayat hidup yang bisa bergerak bebas karena kegelapan di tulangnya. Orang-orang salah berpikir dia masih punya jiwa, tapi sebenarnya dikendalikan oleh kekuatan gelap. Tidak pandai dan tidak merasakan sakit, tapi punya keinginan besar untuk bertahan hidup. Katanya dia menyerang mereka yang punya jiwa karena cemburu.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60050_DESCRIPTION
desc: An undead monster that moves freely thanks to the power of darkness in its bones. People tend to mistakenly think it still has a soul, but it is actually controlled by a dark force. It is unintelligent and doesn't sense pain, but it does have a very strong will to survive. It's said that it attacks those with a soul out to envy.

raw.en: An undead monster that moves freely thanks to the power of darkness in its bones. People tend to mistakenly think it still has a soul, but it is actually controlled by a dark force. It is unintelligent and doesn't sense pain, but it does have a very strong will to survive. It's said that it attacks those with a soul out to envy.
raw.es: Zombi revivido gracias al poder de la oscuridad. La gente piensa que siguen teniendo alma, pero en realidad son las fuerzas del mal quienes lo controlan. Son torpes y no sienten el dolor, pero tienen unas irrefrenables ganas de vivir. Dicen que atacan a todo aquel con alma por envidia.
raw.id: Monster mayat hidup yang bisa bergerak bebas karena kegelapan di tulangnya. Orang-orang salah berpikir dia masih punya jiwa, tapi sebenarnya dikendalikan oleh kekuatan gelap. Tidak pandai dan tidak merasakan sakit, tapi punya keinginan besar untuk bertahan hidup. Katanya dia menyerang mereka yang punya jiwa karena cemburu.
raw.pt: Um monstro morto-vivo que se move livremente graças ao poder sombrio em seus ossos. As pessoas tendem a achar por engano que ele possui uma alma, mas na verdade é controlado por uma força sombria. Ele não é inteligente e não sente dor, mas tem uma forte vontade de sobreviver. Dizem que ele ataca por inveja aqueles que possuem uma alma.
raw.th: อันเดดที่เคลื่อนไหวได้อย่างอิสระจากพลังจากความมืดในกระดูกของมัน คนมันจะเข้าใจผิดคิดว่าพวกมันยังมีวิญญาณเหลืออยู่ แต่แท้ที่จริงพวกมันถูกควบคุมโดยพลังมืด มันไม่ฉลาดและไม่รับรู้ความเจ็บปวด แต่พวกมันมีความมุ่งมันสูงมากในการเอาชีวิตรอด ว่ากันว่ามันโจมตีทุกสิ่งที่มีวิญญารเพราะความอิจฉา
raw.vi: Một con quái vật bất tử di chuyển tự do nhờ vào sức mạnh của bóng tối trong xương tủy nó. Con người có xu hướng nhầm lẫn nghĩ rằng nó vẫn có một linh hồn, nhưng nó thực sự được điều khiển bởi một thế lực đen tối. Nó không thông minh và không cảm nhận được nỗi đau, nhưng nó có ý chí rất mạnh mẽ để tồn tại. Người ta nói rằng nó tấn công những người có linh hồn hay ghen tị.

id: Monster mayat hidup yang bisa bergerak bebas karena kegelapan di tulangnya. Dia mengumpulkan pengalaman dan kearifan dalam perang. Kemampuan tempurnya jadi lebih kuat karena dia belajar cara memakai zirah dan perisai. Lebih ganas terhadap yang hidup, dan lebih dari kemenangan grup, dia berharap akan kematian lawannya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60051_DESCRIPTION
desc: An undead monster that moves freely thanks to the power of darkness in its bones. It gains experience and wisdom through battle. Its combat ability is greatly enhanced due to having learned it can equip armor and a shield. It is more hostile towards the living, and more than group victories, it tends to strongly wish for its opponents' death.

raw.en: An undead monster that moves freely thanks to the power of darkness in its bones. It gains experience and wisdom through battle. Its combat ability is greatly enhanced due to having learned it can equip armor and a shield. It is more hostile towards the living, and more than group victories, it tends to strongly wish for its opponents' death.
raw.es: Zombi revivido gracias al poder de la oscuridad, que ha ido ganando experiencia y sabiduría con la lucha. Además, ha aprendido a protegerse con una coraza y un escudo. Es hostil con los vivos y más que luchar por la victoria, su fin es arrebatarle la vida al contrario.
raw.id: Monster mayat hidup yang bisa bergerak bebas karena kegelapan di tulangnya. Dia mengumpulkan pengalaman dan kearifan dalam perang. Kemampuan tempurnya jadi lebih kuat karena dia belajar cara memakai zirah dan perisai. Lebih ganas terhadap yang hidup, dan lebih dari kemenangan grup, dia berharap akan kematian lawannya.
raw.pt: Um monstro morto-vivo que se move livremente graças ao poder sombrio em seus ossos. Ele ganha experiência e sabedoria através da batalha. Sua habilidade de combate é ampliada devido a ele ter aprendido que pode usar armadura e escudo. Ele é mais hostil contra os vivos, e mais do que vitórias em grupo, ele tende a desejar a morte de seus oponentes.
raw.th: อันเดดที่เคลื่อนไหวได้อย่างอิสระจากพลังจากความมืดในกระดูกของมัน มันได้รับประสบการณ์และปัญญาผ่านการต่อสู้ ทักษะในการต่อสู้ของมันเพิ่มขึ้นมาเพราะได้เรียนรู้ มันสามารถสวมใส่เพราะและโล่ มันยิ่งไม่เป็นมิตรสำหรับสิ่งมีชีวิตและไม่สนชัยชนะของกลุ่ม แต่สนเรื่องทำให้ศัตรูตายเสียมากกว่า
raw.vi: Một con quái vật bất tử di chuyển tự do nhờ vào sức mạnh của bóng tối trong xương tủy nó. Nó lấy được kinh nghiệm và sự khôn ngoan thông qua các trận chiến. Khả năng chiến đấu của nó được tăng cường rất nhiều do nó học được cách có thể trang bị áo giáp và lá chắn. Nó thù địch hơn đối với cuộc sống, và nhóm chiến thắng, nó có xu hướng mong muốn mạnh mẽ đối thủ chết.

id: Monster mayat hidup yang dilahirkan dari tulang yang diberi kekuatan kegelapan. Meskipun biasanya mereka tidak tertarik dengan apapun selain musuh di depannya, kadang-kadang ada individu yang tampak memberikan komando kepada grup besar untuk membunuh lebih banyak orang. Perintah menyebutkan kalau ada Jerangkong yang berbahaya ini ditemukan, mereka harus segera dimusnahkan. Suka menyerang desa, di mana tulang dari orang mati menjadi Jerangkong baru, mengabaikan serangan mereka akan membuat pasukan mereka bertambah besar.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60052_DESCRIPTION
desc: An undead monster born from bones infused with the power of darkness. Though normally they show little interest outside of the enemy in front of them, occassionally individuals appear that command larger groups in hopes of leading more to their deaths. Orders are in place that say should one of these especially harmful Skeletons be discovered it should be immediately destroyed. With their love for preying on villages, where the bones of the dead then become new Skeletons, ignoring their threat would only lead to their army growing stronger.

raw.en: An undead monster born from bones infused with the power of darkness. Though normally they show little interest outside of the enemy in front of them, occassionally individuals appear that command larger groups in hopes of leading more to their deaths. Orders are in place that say should one of these especially harmful Skeletons be discovered it should be immediately destroyed. With their love for preying on villages, where the bones of the dead then become new Skeletons, ignoring their threat would only lead to their army growing stronger.
raw.es: Un monstruo nacido de la fusión entre huesos y el poder de la oscuridad. Aunque normalmente esta especie no muestra interés por otra cosa más que el enemigo que tiene en frente, en ocasiones se suele encontrar a alguien al mando de grupos más grandes con la esperanza de quitarle la vida a una mayor cantidad de personas. Existen órdenes que establecen que estos peligrosos seres deben ser destruidos inmediatamente en caso de ser descubiertos. Les apasiona asaltar a los pueblos desprevenidos, donde luego, los huesos de los asesinados se convierten en nuevos esqueletos. Ignorar su amenaza significaría un aumento en la cantidad de soldados de su ejército.
raw.id: Monster mayat hidup yang dilahirkan dari tulang yang diberi kekuatan kegelapan. Meskipun biasanya mereka tidak tertarik dengan apapun selain musuh di depannya, kadang-kadang ada individu yang tampak memberikan komando kepada grup besar untuk membunuh lebih banyak orang. Perintah menyebutkan kalau ada Jerangkong yang berbahaya ini ditemukan, mereka harus segera dimusnahkan. Suka menyerang desa, di mana tulang dari orang mati menjadi Jerangkong baru, mengabaikan serangan mereka akan membuat pasukan mereka bertambah besar.
raw.pt: Um monstro morto-vivo nascido de ossos injetados com o poder sombrio. Embora normalmente demonstrem pouco interesse além do inimigo que está adiante, ocasionalmente aparecem indivíduos que comandam grupos maiores na esperança de levarem mais ao caminho da morte. Há ordens estabelecidas que dizem que, se um desses esqueletos perigosos for descoberto, ele deve ser destruído imediatamente. Com sua paixão por caçar em vilarejos, onde os ossos dos mortos se transformam em novos esqueletos, ignorar esta ameaça só levaria ao fortalecimento desse exército.
raw.th: มอนสเตอร์อันเดดที่เกิดจากกระดูกผสมกับพลังของความมืด แม้ปกติพวกมันจะไม่ค่อยสนใจสิ่งอื่นนอกเหนือจากศัตรูที่อยู่เบื้องหน้า ก็มีบ้างที่บางตัวจะแสดงตัวเป็นผู้บัญชาการของกลุ่มที่ใหญ่กว่าโดยหวังว่าจะนำพาความตายมามากขึ้นกว่าเดิม มีคำสั่งที่ประกาศไว้ว่าถ้ามีใครค้นพบโครงกระดูกพิเศษที่เป็นอันตรายเหล่านี้ จะต้องทำลายพวกมันทิ้งโดยทันที เพราะพวกมันชอบล่าเหยื่อตามหมู่บ้าน ที่ซึ่งกระดูกของคนตายก็จะกลายเป็นหนึ่งในพวกของมัน การเพิกเฉยต่อการคุกคามของพวกมันจะเป็นการปล่อยให้กองทัพของพวกมันนั้นแข็งแกร่งขึ้นจนน่ากลัว
raw.vi: Một con quái vật chưa chết được sinh ra từ xương được truyền cho sức mạnh hắc ám. Mặc dù bình thường chúng ít quan tâm đến ngoài kẻ thù trước mặt chúng, thỉnh thoảng có những cá thể xuất hiện chỉ huy những nhóm lớn hơn với hy vọng khiến nhiều người chết hơn nữa. Các nội quy được đặt ra nói rằng nếu một trong những Bộ xương đặc biệt nguy hại bị phát hiện thì nó phải bị tiêu diệt ngay lập tức. Với việc yêu thích đi săn trên những ngôi làng, nơi những xương người chết lại trở thành những Bộ xương mới, việc bỏ qua mối đe dọa của chúng khiến quân đội của chúng ngày càng lớn mạnh.

id: Setan dengan ular sebagai rambutnya. Manusia yang melihat ke matanya dikutuk dan menjadi batu. Tidak hanya sangat beracun, ular di kepalanya punya vitalitas tinggi dan akan hidup cukup lama meskipun dipotong dari kepalanya. Banyak prajurit yang kehilangan nyawanya karena ular-ular ini, membuat Medusa setan yang berbahaya meskipun telah dikalahkan.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60061_DESCRIPTION
desc: A demon with snakes instead of hair. Humans who look into her eyes are cursed and turned to stone. Not only are they highly poisonous, the snakes on her head have high vitality and will live for a while even if cut from her head. Many soldiers have lost their lives to these snakes, making Medusa a dangerous demon even after she's been defeated.

raw.en: A demon with snakes instead of hair. Humans who look into her eyes are cursed and turned to stone. Not only are they highly poisonous, the snakes on her head have high vitality and will live for a while even if cut from her head. Many soldiers have lost their lives to these snakes, making Medusa a dangerous demon even after she's been defeated.
raw.es: Monstruo con serpientes en el pelo. Los humanos que la miran a los ojos se convierten en piedra. Sus serpientes no son solo venenosas, sino que tienen una gran vitalidad y se mantendrán vivas aunque se las arranques. Muchos soldados han sido su bocado, incluso después de haber derrotado a su dueña.
raw.id: Setan dengan ular sebagai rambutnya. Manusia yang melihat ke matanya dikutuk dan menjadi batu. Tidak hanya sangat beracun, ular di kepalanya punya vitalitas tinggi dan akan hidup cukup lama meskipun dipotong dari kepalanya. Banyak prajurit yang kehilangan nyawanya karena ular-ular ini, membuat Medusa setan yang berbahaya meskipun telah dikalahkan.
raw.pt: Um demônio com cobras no lugar do cabelo. Humanos que olham em seus olhos são transformados em pedra. Não bastasse serem altamente venenosas, as cobras em sua cabeça ainda são resistentes e vão sobreviver por um tempo mesmo se cortadas. Muitos soldados perderam sua vida para essas cobras, fazendo da Medusa um demônio perigoso mesmo após a morte.
raw.th: ปีศาจที่มีผมเป็นงู มนุษย์ที่จ้องตาเธอจะถูกสาปให้กลายเป็นหิน ไม่เพียงแค่พวกมันมีพิษที่ร้ายกาจแต่งูบนหัวนั้นมีพลังชีวิตที่มากและจะมีชีวิตอยู่ต่อไปสักพักแม้ว่าจะตัดหัวของเธอออกก็ตาม ทหารมากมายเสียชีวิตเพราะงูพวกนี้ทำให้ "เมดูซ่า" เป็นปีศาจที่น่ากลัวแม้กระทั่งยามที่เธอถูกสังหารไปแล้วก็ตาม
raw.vi: Một con quỷ tóc rắn. Con người ai nhìn vào mắt mụ đều bị nguyền rủa và biến thành đá. Không chỉ có độ độc cao, những con rắn trên đầu mụ có sức sống cao và sẽ sống một thời gian ngay cả khi bị cắt ra. Nhiều binh sĩ đã thiệt mạng vì những con rắn, khiến Medusa trở thành con quỷ nguy hiểm ngay cả sau khi mụ bị đánh bại.

id: Setan dengan ular yang lapar akan otak sebagai bahunya. Katanya Zahhak mendapat pengetahuan dari orang yang otaknya dimakannya, jadi dia cenderung mengincar mereka yang pandai. Mereka takut akan Zahhak lebih dari setan lain, dan namanya membuat mereka bergidik. Beberapa Pemanggil mendapat hadiah besar dari para cendekiawan untuk membunuh Zahhak.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60062_DESCRIPTION
desc: A demon with four brain-hungry snakes growing from her shoulders. It's said that Zahhak gains the knowledge of the person whose brains she eats, so she has a tendency to target intellectuals. They fear Zahhak more than other demons, and her name makes them shiver. Some Summoners receive great rewards from intellectuals for exterminating Zahhaks.

raw.en: A demon with four brain-hungry snakes growing from her shoulders. It's said that Zahhak gains the knowledge of the person whose brains she eats, so she has a tendency to target intellectuals. They fear Zahhak more than other demons, and her name makes them shiver. Some Summoners receive great rewards from intellectuals for exterminating Zahhaks.
raw.es: Monstruo con cuatro hambrientas serpientes que le salen de los hombros. Dicen que puede absorber el intelecto de sus víctimas comiéndose sus cerebros, así que busca intelectuales. Esos temen a Zahnak más que a ningún demonio y tiemblan con solo escuchar su nombre. Algunos incluso han contratado invocadores para que acabaran con ellas.
raw.id: Setan dengan ular yang lapar akan otak sebagai bahunya. Katanya Zahhak mendapat pengetahuan dari orang yang otaknya dimakannya, jadi dia cenderung mengincar mereka yang pandai. Mereka takut akan Zahhak lebih dari setan lain, dan namanya membuat mereka bergidik. Beberapa Pemanggil mendapat hadiah besar dari para cendekiawan untuk membunuh Zahhak.
raw.pt: Um demônio com quatro serpentes famintas por cérebros em seus ombros. Dizem que Zahhak ganha o conhecimento de pessoas cujo cérebro ela devora, então ela tem uma tendência a tomar intelectuais como alvo. Eles temem Zahhak mais do que qualquer outro demônio, e seu nome lhes dá calafrios. Alguns Invocadores recebem grandes recompensas de intelectuais por exterminarem Zahhaks.
raw.th: ปีศาจที่มีงูที่ชอบกินสมองสี่ตัวโผล่ออกมาจากบ่าของเธอ ว่ากันว่า "ซาฮัค" ได้รับความรู้จากคนที่มันกินสมองเข้าไป ดังนั้นเธอจึงมีแนวโน้มที่จะกำหนดเป้าหมายเป็นพวกปัญญาชน พวกเขากลัวซาฮัคมากกว่าปีศาจชนิดอื่นๆ และชื่อของเธอก็ทำให้พวกนั้นเสียววาบ ซัมมอนเนอร์บางคนได้รับรางวัลยิ่งใหญ่จากพวกปัญญาชน สำหรับการจัดการซาฮัค
raw.vi: Một con quỷ có bốn con rắn muốn ăn não trên vai. Người ta nói rằng Zahhak có được kiến thức của người bị mụ ăn não, vì vậy mụ có xu hướng nhắm mục tiêu tới người trí thức. Họ sợ Zahhak hơn quỷ khác, và tên của mụ làm cho họ rùng mình. Một số người triệu hồi nhận được phần thưởng lớn từ giới trí thức để diệt Zahhaks.

id: Setan tingkat tinggi yang punya sarang di reruntuhan padang pasir yang katanya telah memakan banyak pengembara. Tapi, ada suatu waktu di mana cerita pertemuan dengan setan ini di reruntuhan tiba-tiba berhenti. Lalu, gosip muncul bahwa Lulujann telah diundang oleh satu dari para pengembara itu untuk mengembara di dunia bersama-sama. Berpikir bahwa ini sangat tidak masuk akal, para sarjana menyimpulkan bahwa setan ini dibunuh oleh pahlawan tak dikenal dalam reruntuhan itu.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_60063_DESCRIPTION
desc: A higher ranking demon nesting in desert ruins who is said to have devoured a large number of adventurers for sustenance. However, there was a period of time in which tales of encounters with this demon in the ruins came to an abrupt stop. Later, rumors surfaced that Lulujann had been invited by one of those adventurers to experience the outside world together. Thinking this completely absurd, scholars came to the conclusion that the demon was slain by an unknown hero within the ruins.

raw.en: A higher ranking demon nesting in desert ruins who is said to have devoured a large number of adventurers for sustenance. However, there was a period of time in which tales of encounters with this demon in the ruins came to an abrupt stop. Later, rumors surfaced that Lulujann had been invited by one of those adventurers to experience the outside world together. Thinking this completely absurd, scholars came to the conclusion that the demon was slain by an unknown hero within the ruins.
raw.es: Se dice que este demonio de alto rango que habita en las ruinas desérticas ha devorado a una gran cantidad de personas para mantenerse con vida. Sin embargo, en los libros se cuenta que hubo un periodo en que la gente dejó de encontrarse con este demonio. Luego, se conocieron rumores de que un aventurero había invitado a Lulujann a conocer el mundo juntos. Los eruditos, que pensaban que esto era completamente absurdo, llegaron a la conclusión de que un héroe desconocido había asesinado al demonio.
