raw.pt: Conforme os anos passavam, o elo entre Semira e Jack ficava mais forte, e eles ficaram nas florestas protegendo o antigo santuário do mal. Nesse período, Semira conheceu Ciara, ferida por um feroz ataque demoníaco. Ela acolheu Ciara e a treinou nas artes sombrias que aprendera de Jack. Um dia, uma aura familiar entrou na floresta. Semira sabia de imediato que era o cavaleiro louco que matou seu pai. Quando surgiu da escuridão, o cavaleiro a atacou de pronto. Ela ergueu Jack, que brilhou com a luz de mil sóis. Em um golpe, o cavaleiro virou uma bola de fogo e caiu. Jack olhou na alma do cavaleiro e a acorrentou a si, para sempre um escravo espiritual da dupla. E quando a bola de fogo desapareceu, só restou a foice que o pai de Semira havia forjado para o cavaleiro, antes de morrer.
raw.th: ขณะที่ผ่านไปหลายปี พันธะของเซมิร่ากับแจ็คก็ยิ่งเติบโตแข็งแกร่งมากขึ้น พวกเขาอาศัยในป่ามืดเพื่อปกป้องเขตศักดิ์สิทธิ์โบราณจากปีศาจและความชั่วร้าย ระหว่างช่วงนี้ เซมิร่าได้พบกับเซียร่าที่บาดเจ็บและปางตายจากการโจมตีที่ดุร้ายของปีศาจ เธอรับเซียร่ามาดูแล และฝึกฝนเธอด้วยศาสตร์ที่ได้เรียนรู้มาจากแจ็ค วันหนึ่ง รัศมีที่คุ้นเคยได้เข้ามาในป่า เซมิร่ารู้โดยทันทีว่ามันคืออัศวินคลั่งผู้สังหารพ่อของเธอ ขณะที่เธอโผล่ออกมาจากความมืด อัศวินคลั่งก็เริ่มพุ่งเข้าจู่โจมเธอ เธอชูแจ็คขึ้นมาซึ่งส่องแสงสว่างราวกับพระอาทิตย์นับพันดวง ด้วยการโจมตีเพียงครั้งดียว อัศวินมืดก็ระเบิดเป็นลูกไฟและร่วงลง แจ็คจ้องไปยังวิญญาณของอัศวินคลั่งและผูกมัดวิญญาณของเขาไว้กับตัวเอง และเปลี่ยนให้เป็นวิญญาณทาสของทั้งคู่ไปตลอดกาล และขณะที่ลูกไฟกำลังมอดลง บนพื้นนั่นก็มีเคียวที่พ่อของเซมิร่าได้หลอมขึ้นมาไว้สำหรับอัศวินคลั่งก่อนที่เขาจะตาย
raw.vi: Năm tháng trôi qua, Semira và kết nối của Jack đã lớn mạnh hơn, họ đã ở lại trong rừng thẳm bảo vệ những khu bảo tồn cổ xưa khỏi lũ ma quỷ và sự mục nát. Trong thời gian này, Semira đã gặp Ciara, đang bị thương và đau đớn bởi cuộc tấn công của lũ quỷ xấu xa. Nàng đã mang Ciara về và mài dũa cô về nghệ thuật hắc ám mà nàng đã học được từ Jack. Một ngày, một vầng hào quang quen thuộc tiến vào khu rừng. Semira biết ngay rằng đó là tên hiệp sĩ điên đã giết chết cha mình. Khi nàng bước ra khỏi bóng tối, tên hiệp sĩ điên bắt đầu lao về phía nàng. Nàng đã giơ Jack lên cao tỏa ra ánh sáng bằng cả ngàn mặt trời rực lửa. Chỉ bằng một đòn, tên hiệp sĩ điên đã bùng cháy thành quả cầu lửa và ngã xuống. Jack nhìn chằm chằm vào linh hồn tên hiệp sĩ điên và trói buộc linh hồn hắn với chính mình, để hắn mãi mãi là một nô lệ linh hồn cho bộ đôi này. Và khi quả cầu lửa cháy hết, trên mặt đất chính là lưỡi hái của cha Semira đã rèn được cho tên hiệp sĩ điên đấy trước khi ông qua đời.

id: Setelah kepergian Ciara, Semira tetap melindungi suaka kuno dengan bantuan Jack, penyelamatnya. Melatih keahliannya dengan panduan Jack, dia bisa mengontrol jiwa ksatria gila yang ditangkapnya membuatnya menjadi seorang penjaga. Ada gosip yang mengatakan bahwa kekuatan jahat sekalipun tidak berani masuk ke suaka itu karena takut menghadapi kemarahan Semira.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_860106_DESCRIPTION
desc: After Ciara's departure, Semira continued protecting the ancient sanctuary with the help of Jack, her savior. Honing her powers with Jack's guidance, she was able to take control of the captured mad knight's soul, turning him into a guardian. There had been rumors that even evil forces dared not traverse into the sanctuary in fear of encountering Semira's wrath.

Los rumores cuentan que incluso las fuerzas malignas no se atreven a ingresar al santuario por miedo a encontrarse con la ira de Semira.

Houve muitos rumores de que forças malignas não ousam entrar no santuário com medo de enfrentarem a ira de Semira.
raw.th: หลังจากการจากไปของเซียร่า เซมิร่าปกป้องสถานที่ศักดิ์สิทธิ์โบราณต่อไปด้วยความช่วยเหลือของแจ็คผู้ที่ช่วยชีวิตเธอไว้ ฝึกฝนพลังของเธอด้วยการชี้นำของแจ็ค เธอสามารถเข้าควบคุมวิญญาณของอัศวินคลั่งที่ถูกจับมาและเปลี่ยนเขาให้เป็นผู้พิทักษ์ มีข่าวลือว่าแม้แต่พลังชั่วร้ายก็ไม่กล้าที่จะย่างกรายเข้ามาในเขตศักดิ์สิทธิ์เพราะความกลัวที่จะต้องพบกับความพิโรธของเซมิร่า
raw.vi: Sau khi Ciara lên đường, Semira đã tiếp tục bảo vệ khu điện thờ cổ xưa với sự giúp đỡ của Jack, vị cứu tinh của nàng. Rèn luyện sức mạnh của mình với sự hướng dẫn của Jack, nàng đã có thể kiểm soát linh hồn tên hiệp sĩ điên để biến hắn thành cận vệ. Đã có lời đồn rằng ngay cả những thế lực ma quỷ cũng không dám đi qua điện thờ bởi sợ hãi hay gặp phải cơn thịnh nộ của Semira.

desc: A group of Burnies came across a pumpkin field and decided to fuse their bodies with the pumpkins, which granted them an extra buffer to their strength and defense.

id: Cyclaw diciptakan oleh Gazia, makhluk setengah dewa yang jatuh dalam jurang kekuatan dan posisinya pada waktu perang augmentasi di Athensphere. Dibuat berbentuk beast legendaris untuk meniru besar badannya dan agresi yang menjadi simbol kehancuran dan kekuatan. Katanya, jiwa dari seorang cyclops yang kuat ditambahkan ke mekaniknya untuk membuatnya mampu melindas tanah dan menyebabkan kehancuran dan kekacauan, meledakkan semua yang menghalanginya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_810124_DESCRIPTION
desc: Cyclaw was created by Gazia, a demi-god fallen into his abyss of power and stature during the days of the augmentation wars in Athensphere. It was built in the form of a strong legendary beast to mimic its formidable size and aggression as a symbol of destruction and power. It was said that the powerful soul of a living cyclops was infused into its mechanical processes to enable it to rampage through the lands, aiming to cause destruction and chaos, while blasting through everything in its way.

raw.es: Cigarra fue creado por Gazia, un semidiós que cayó en un abismo de poder y reputación durante los días de las Guerras de la Amplificación en Atenasfera. Le dieron forma de una bestia fuerte y mítica para que tuviera gran tamaño y agresividad, y se creó como símbolo de destrucción y poder. Se dice que también le insuflaron en sus procesos mecánicos el alma de un cíclope vivo para que sembrara el caos en las tierras y aniquilara todo lo que encontrara en su camino.
raw.id: Cyclaw diciptakan oleh Gazia, makhluk setengah dewa yang jatuh dalam jurang kekuatan dan posisinya pada waktu perang augmentasi di Athensphere. Dibuat berbentuk beast legendaris untuk meniru besar badannya dan agresi yang menjadi simbol kehancuran dan kekuatan. Katanya, jiwa dari seorang cyclops yang kuat ditambahkan ke mekaniknya untuk membuatnya mampu melindas tanah dan menyebabkan kehancuran dan kekacauan, meledakkan semua yang menghalanginya.
raw.pt: Cyclaw foi criado por Gazia, um semideus que havia decaído de seu de poder e renome durante os dias das guerras dos implantes de Athensphere. Foi construído na forma de uma besta lendária, para imitar seu tamanho e agressão formidáveis, como demonstração de poder e destruição. Dizem que a poderosa alma de um ciclope vivo foi fundida a seus processos mecânicos, para permiti-lo acossar as terras buscando a destruição e o caos, explodindo tudo em seu caminho.
raw.th: ไซคลอว์ถูกสร้างขึ้นโดย กาเซีย , พวกครึ่งเทพที่ตกไปอยู่ในห้วงลึกแห่งพลังและความสำเร็จ ในช่วงสงครามที่เพิ่มขึ้นมาในอาเทนสเฟียร์ มันถูกสร้างเป็นรูปร่างของอสูรกายในตำนานที่แข็งแกร่งเพื่อเลียนแบบขนาดที่ดูน่ากลัวและความดุร้ายในฐานะสัญลักษณ์ของการทำลายล้างและพลัง ว่ากันว่าดวงวิญญาณที่ทรงพลังของไซคลอปที่มีชีวิตถูกผสมเข้าไปในกลไกของมันเพื่อทำให้มันสามารถอาละวาดไปทั่วดินแดนโดยมุ่งเป้าทำลายล้างและสร้างความโกลาหล ระเบิดทุกอย่างที่ขวางทางให้กระจุย
raw.vi: Cyclaw được tạo ra bởi Gazia, một á thần rơi vào vực thẳm của sức mạnh và tầm vóc trong những ngày diễn ra những cuộc chiến tranh mở rộng ở Athensphere. Nó được xây dựng trong hình dạng của một con quái vật huyền thoại mạnh mẽ để bắt chước kích thước ghê gớm và sự hung hăng của nó như một biểu tượng của sự hủy diệt và sức mạnh. Tương truyền rằng linh hồn mạnh mẽ của người khổng lồ một mắt còn sống đã được truyền vào các quy trình cơ khí của nó để làm cho nó nổi cơn thịnh nộ qua các vùng đất nhằm gây ra sự hủy diệt và hỗn loạn, làm nổ tung mọi thứ theo cách của nó.

id: Ultor diciptakan oleh para dewa kuno, dilahirkan dari api dan batu sebagai setengah dewa. Dia punya keinginan alami untuk perang dan kehormatan, mempunyai kekuatan bagai seribu orang dan punya talenta besar dalam pertarungan. Zedus pemimpin dari para makhluk setengah dewa melihat potensinya dan menempatkan sebagai pemimpin untuk melindungi tanah yang hilang, Athensphere. Kekuatan pertahanan Athensphere tidak perhan kalah sekalipun dalam perang di bawah pimpinan Ultor. Dia diperintahkan oleh Zedus untuk memimpin pasukan melawan Gazia, yang melakukan eksperimen ilegal tentang teknologi augmentasi dan penghancur, yang memulai perang augmentasi.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_810134_DESCRIPTION
desc: Ultor was created by the old gods, birthed from fire and stone. He had a natural desire for battle and glory, wields the strength of a thousand men, and has great talent in combat. Zedus, the leader of the demi-gods, saw his potential and placed him in charge of defending the lost lands of Athensphere. Athensphere's defense force never lost a single battle while under Ultor's leadership. He was ordered by Zedus to lead his force against Gazia, who was experimenting illegal augmentations and destructive technology, thus starting the Augmentation Wars.

raw.es: Los dioses antiguos crearon a Ultor, desde la piedra y el fuego. Tiene un deseo natural de batalla y gloria, blande la fuerza de mil hombres y su talento en el combate es avasallante. Zedus, el líder de los semidioses, vio su potencial y le ordenó proteger las tierras perdidas de Atenasfera. Los defensores de dicha ciudad nunca perdieron una batalla mientras Ultor fue el comandante. Zedus le ordenó dirigir su fuerza contra Gazia, que estaba experimentando con métodos de amplificación ilegales y tecnología de destrucción. Esto dio inicio a las Guerras de la Amplificación.
raw.id: Ultor diciptakan oleh para dewa kuno, dilahirkan dari api dan batu sebagai setengah dewa. Dia punya keinginan alami untuk perang dan kehormatan, mempunyai kekuatan bagai seribu orang dan punya talenta besar dalam pertarungan. Zedus pemimpin dari para makhluk setengah dewa melihat potensinya dan menempatkan sebagai pemimpin untuk melindungi tanah yang hilang, Athensphere. Kekuatan pertahanan Athensphere tidak perhan kalah sekalipun dalam perang di bawah pimpinan Ultor. Dia diperintahkan oleh Zedus untuk memimpin pasukan melawan Gazia, yang melakukan eksperimen ilegal tentang teknologi augmentasi dan penghancur, yang memulai perang augmentasi.
raw.pt: Ultor foi criado pelos velhos deuses, nascido do fogo e da pedra. Ele tem um gosto natural pela batalha e glória, tem a força de mil homens e um talento prodigioso em combate. Zedus, líder dos semideuses, viu esse potencial e o encarregou da defesa das terras perdidas de Athensphere. A força de defesa de Athensphere não perdeu uma única batalha sob o comando de Ultor. Zedus ordenou que ele liderasse suas forças contra Gazia, que estava pesquisando implantes ilegais e tecnologias destrutivas, iniciando assim as tecnoguerras.
raw.th: อัลทอร์ถูกสร้างโดยเทพเจ้าเก่า เกิดมาจากหินและไฟ เขามีแรงปรารถนาตามธรรมชาติกับการต่อสู้และศักดิ์ศรี ด้วยความแข็งแกร่งของคนหนึ่งพันและทักษะที่เยี่ยมในการต่อสู้ ซีดุส หัวหน้าของพวกครึ่งเทพได้มองเห็นศักยภาพของเขาและได้มอบหมายหน้าที่ให้กับเขาในการป้องกันดินแดนที่สาบสูญแห่งอาเทนสเฟียร์ กองกำลังป้องกันของอาเทนสเฟียร์ไม่เคยแพ้การรบแม้แต่ครั้งเดียวขณะอยู่ใต้การชี้นำของอัลทอร์ เขาถูกสั่งโดยซีดุสเพื่อนำกองกำลังของเขาต่อสู้กับกาเซีย ผู้ที่ทำการทดลองเทคโนโลยีการทำลายล้างและการเพิ่มเติมอย่างผิดกฎหมาย จนเป็นจุดเริ่มของสงครามเพิ่มเติม
raw.vi: Ultor được tạo ra bởi các vị thần già, được sinh ra từ lửa và đá. Anh có mong muốn tự nhiên được chiến đấu và giành vinh quang, nắm giữ sức mạnh của hàng ngàn người và có tài năng tuyệt vời trong chiến đấu. Zedus chỉ huy của các á thần đã nhìn thấy tiềm năng của anh và giao cho anh trọng trách bảo vệ các vùng đất bị mất của Athensphere. Lực lượng bảo vệ của Athensphere chưa bao giờ thua một trận chiến nào khi còn dưới sự chỉ huy của Ultor. Anh đã được Zedus ra lệnh chỉ huy lực lượng của mình chống lại Gazia, người đã thử nghiệm mở rộng bất hợp pháp và công nghệ hủy diệt, do đó bắt đầu chiến tranh mở rộng.

name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_810135_DESCRIPTION
desc: Ultor was created by the old gods, birthed from fire and stone. He had a natural desire for battle and glory, wields the strength of a thousand men, and has great talent in combat. He was in charge of defending the lost lands of Athensphere, appointed by the leader of the demi-gods, Zedus. Athensphere's defense force never lost a single battle until Gazia, a corrupted demi-god, went on the offensive against the utopian lands, throwing everything into chaos. Although Ultor never lost his fights, the defensive force had fallen, and Athenshpere was forsaken by the old gods, cast into the abyss of the Vortex. Till today, he fights on, struggling to reclaim and preserve the promised utopian lands of Athensphere.

raw.vi: Ultor được tạo ra bởi các vị thần già, được sinh ra từ lửa và đá dưới dạng một á thần. Anh có mong muốn tự nhiên được chiến đấu và giành vinh quang, nắm giữ sức mạnh của hàng ngàn người và có tài năng tuyệt vời trong chiến đấu. Anh phụ trách bảo vệ các vùng đất bị mất của Athensphere theo sự chỉ định của chỉ huy của các á thần, Zedus. Mặc dù Ultor chưa bao giờ thua trong các trận đánh của mình, nhưng lực lượng bảo vệ đã ngã xuống và Athenshpere bị các vị thần già bỏ rơi, ném xuống vực thẳm của Vortex. Cho đến ngày nay, anh vẫn chiến đấu, đấu tranh để đòi lại và bảo tồn các vùng đất hứa mang tính duy tâm của Athensphere.

id: Ultor diciptakan oleh para dewa kuno, dilahirkan dari api dan batu sebagai setengah dewa. name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_810146_DESCRIPTION
desc: Ultor was created by the old gods, birthed from fire and stone. He had a natural desire for battle and glory, wields the strength of a thousand men, and has great talent in combat. Although he never lost a fight, his defensive force was overcome by the sheer power of Gazia's iron army during the Augmentation Wars. Zedus saw that even as demi-gods they could grow tired, but Gazia's iron army never fatigued. In desperation, he ordered the demi-gods to use whatever means necessary to effectively wipe out the enemy and end the destruction, even if they themselves were to rely on augmentations. When Ultor finally defeated a powerful Cyclaw, he decided that its strength was an advantage to him, so he bound his soul with the mechanical brain of its remains and emerged from the rubbles a titan of a demi-god.

Por esa razón, vinculó su alma con el cerebro mecánico de su enemigo y emergió de las ruinas en forma de semidiós titánico.

id: Biduanita dari dunia lain. Tarian cerianya memukau penghuni Gaia Besar; manusia, monster, dan dewa semuanya. Dia muncul di puing kuno tempat biduanita berambut hijau pertama kali terlihat. Lagu dan tarian mereka saling melengkapi. Aksi energetiknya beserta suara imutnya memberikan rasa istirahat sebentar untuk penghuni Gaia Besar yang sedang perang. Seorang penyair yang amat mirip dengan Rin muncul di sisinya, tapi hubungan mereka tetap menjadi misteri.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_840204_DESCRIPTION
desc: A songstress who appeared from another world. Her cheerful dancing enraptured the denizens of Grand Gaia; humans, monsters and gods alike. She appeared in the same ancient ruins that the green-haired songstress was first seen. Their song and dance complemented each other perfectly. Her energetic actions on top of her cute voice instilled a sense of respite amongst the war-consumed denizens of Grand Gaia. A bard that strongly resembled Rin appeared alongside her, but their relationship remains a mystery.

raw.es: Una cantante proveniente de otro mundo. Su alegre danza embelesó a los habitantes de Gran Gaia, ya sean humanos, monstruos o dioses. Apareció en las mismas ruinas ancestrales en las que se había visto a aquella bailarina de cabellos verdes. Sus danzas y cánticos se complementaban perfectamente. Su enérgico modo de moverse y su hermosa voz instilaron una sensación de alivio en los habitantes de Gran Gaia, afligidos por la guerra. id: Penyanyi yang muncul dari dunia lain. Kepribadiannya energik dan manis, tidak berubah bahkan setelah perang, ia terus memberikan kesegaran bagi penduduk Gaia Besar. name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_840206_DESCRIPTION
desc: A songstress who appeared from another world. Keeping her energetic and endearing personality unfazed even after the war, she continued to provide respite to the denizens of Grand Gaia. As her popularity increased along with that of the bard that arrived with her, fans from all across the world journeyed just to experience their seemingly tireless performance. Emitting a pale blue light that fought against the enveloping darkness, they strove to quell the melancholy of the war-ridden world, calming the weeping of those who had lost their loved ones with their melodious voices.

Embora às vezes seja visto com um teclado, relatos mais recentes dizem que sua poderosa voz era só do que precisava para impressionar as plateias. Embora muito parecido com a cantora conhecida como Rin, seu relacionamento é um mistério até hoje. A única coisa que se sabe, é que suas performances como dueto eram incomparáveis.
raw.th: นักร้องชายผู้ปรากฏตัวจากโลกอื่น ว่ากันว่าผมที่สีทองเจิดจรัสของเขาจะส่องประกายสว่างภายใต้แสงไฟเวทีขณะที่เขาแสดงท่วงทำนองที่โด่งดัง ขณะที่บางสิ่งถูกพบเห็นพร้อมกับคีย์บอรืดในมือด้วยเช่นกัน รายงานเพิ่มเติมระยะหลังอ้างว่าเสียงร้องอันทรงพลังของเขาคือทั้งหมดที่เขาต้องการที่จะทิ้งให้ผู้ชมต้องตกตะลึง และแม้ว่าจะดูเหมือนกับนักร้องหญิงที่มีชื่อว่า ริน อย่างมาก แต่ความสัมพันธ์ของพวกเขาก็ยังคงเป็นเรื่องลึกลับตราบจนถึงทุกวันนี้ มีเพียงสิ่งเดียวที่รู้กันอยู่อย่างแน่นอน ว่าการแสดงคู่ดูโอของพวกเขานั้นหาที่เปรียบไม่ได้
raw.vi: Một ca sĩ đến từ một thế giới khác. Tương truyền rằng mái tóc vàng chói sáng của anh tỏa sáng rực rỡ dưới ánh đèn sân khấu khi anh biểu diễn nhiều giai điệu nổi tiếng của mình. Mặc dù đôi khi cũng thấy anh với những phím đàn trong tay, nhưng các báo cáo gần đây hơn cho rằng giọng hát mạnh mẽ của anh là tất cả những gì anh cần để khán giả của anh phải hoàn toàn nể sợ. Và mặc dù rất giống nữ ca sĩ có tên gọi là Rin, mối quan hệ của họ vẫn là một bí ẩn cho đến tận ngày nay. Điều duy nhất được biết chắc chắn, là những màn trình diễn song ca của họ được cho rằng không thể sánh được.
